name: Bauzaar
description: Bauzaar is an e-commerce focused on the merchandising of food and accessories for dogs and cats. Customers can choose the “auto-delivery” option that allows scheduling the frequency of the products’ delivery, without repeating the purchase and payment processes. Bauzaar was launched to allow customers to find quickly the best products for their pets. In fact, it includes over 100 selected brands of pet foods, toys, kennels (and more) of the highest quality and some exclusively available on their website only. All purchases are shipped directly to their customers’ homes and usually the products are delivered in about 2 working days.

name: BeMyEye
description: BeMyEye is a DaaS (Data as a Service) mobile crowdsourcing service for store checks, data collection, and mystery shopping. Thanks to its widespread network of over 1M on-demand workers, BeMyEye can provide fast and accurate observations from thousands of locations in the UK, Italy, Germany, France and Spain. It is used by more than 400 international blue-chip companies as it provides Europe’s largest crowd of real-world data gatherers (the ‘Eyes’), to provide real-time intelligence and actionable in-store retail and street-level data.

name: Biorsaf
description: Biorsaf is a Food RegTech platform that digitises food safety, quality and compliance management for businesses across the food value chain, from HACCP to traceability, cost analysis and labelling. Following its acquisition of Cooki, the company enables food businesses to automate control processes, centralise regulatory data and remove paper from daily operations, cutting operational complexity and saving time across every stage of compliance. With an AI-driven, end-to-end approach, Biorsaf is building Italy's reference platform for digital compliance across the food industry.

name: Bipi
description: Bipi is a company based in Madrid, Spain, offering monthly all-inclusive car subscriptions. Their mission is to replace traditional car ownership with a more flexible and seamless digital experience. With Bipi you can subscribe to the usage of your favorite car in less than 2 minutes, keep it as long as you want, swap it or cancel all for one simple monthly payment with everything included (insurance, maintenance, roadside assistance, and tax). Bipi aims to revolutionize the way people access cars around the world.

name: Buru-Buru
description: Buru Buru is an e-commerce focussing on affordable home design, from furniture to accessories. Every day the Buru Buru team searches for new and interesting designers, with special attention to craft products. Buru Buru is the online shop for people looking for originality and uniqueness in their homes. They select young designers, independent brands and the best products of international brands. From furniture to the most unique and rare accessory, Buru Buru only selects quality products at an affordable price.

name: Bynd
description: Bynd Venture Capital is a leading Iberian early-stage VC, investing in pre-seed and seed technology startups with an Iberian footprint and global ambition. The firm positions itself as a first professional investor for founders building from Portugal and Spain, combining local presence across the main Iberian hubs with a pan-European standard of governance, pace, and follow-on support. Bynd is intentionally multi-sector but thesis-driven around where it sees asymmetric potential—particularly AI & software, consumer goods, and sustainability technology. Its operating model emphasises founder enablement: fast decision cycles, structured feedback, and a platform-led approach that includes an extensive network of connections and an active founder community to accelerate hiring, partnerships, fundraising and operational execution.

name: Carol
description: Carol is a digital healthcare service based in Italy, offering virtual primary care. It provides patients with easy, 24/7 access to medical consultations via video, chat, or on-demand services through a mobile app. With a dedicated team of doctors, Carol allows users to schedule appointments, consult for prescriptions, and access their medical history from anywhere. Its services extend to family members and offer same-day or next-day booking. Designed for individual users and businesses, Carol simplifies healthcare access and management.

name: Casavo
description: Casavo is Italy’s first “instant buyer” and aims to change the lives of both sellers and buyers of residential real estate in Southern Europe. Casavo addresses a critical issue in the property marketplace: it significantly reduces transaction times as it simplifies the process by stepping in as a direct buyer. The company’s automated valuation system takes into consideration dozens of variables and provides potential sellers with the exact value of their property and an immediate purchase offer in real time. After accepting the offer, Casavo carries out a free inspection of the property, while the seller receives the full payment within a matter of days.

name: Citynews
description: CityNews is a dynamic and forward-thinking media company dedicated to delivering timely, accurate, and relevant news and information to urban communities. With a strong commitment to keeping residents and businesses informed, CityNews operates as a trusted source for all things local, including breaking news, events, culture, and lifestyle. The team of dedicated journalists and reporters work tirelessly to provide comprehensive coverage that reflects the diverse interests and needs of our vibrant city. Whether it's through traditional journalism, digital platforms, or social media, CityNews is the go-to resource for staying connected to the heartbeat of your city.

name: Civitfun
description: Civitfun is an online check-in / check-out SaaS (software as a service) for hotels, chain hotels, hostels, villas and vacation rentals. This contactless software allows the digitalization of the traditionally painful check-in / check-out process for any hospitality property, no matter where they operate. This online check-in / check-out process includes integration with the property PMS (Property Management System) being used. This digital online check-in, with the PMS integration helps the hotels avoid the physical contact and then is a contactless solution, hence it’s approved for a non-COVID environment. On top of avoiding physical contact, reducing risks and making the guest feel secure, it provides the hotelier to get their guest details according to their operating country law enforcement. It also improves customer experience since, with Civitfun, the property gets all data digitized in a traditionally manual process, transforming a poor process into something easy, simple and digital.

name: Codemotion
description: Codemotion is the platform that improves developers’ professional growth by connecting IT professionals, tech communities and companies. They bring together the latest tech trends and best practices among the tech community worldwide, help companies to find the perfect dev-match and enhance tech communities’ visibility.

name: Colvin
description: Colvin is a Spanish cut-to-order flower delivery service that offers a wide range of bouquets at accessible prices. The startup company is seeking to change the way people purchase flowers online by providing its customers with an intermediary-free product with quality assurance and a competitive price. On a mission to redefine how we buy flowers, Colvin integrates with growers to sell directly to customers, ensuring flowers arrive fresh and last longer.

name: Connect Ventures
description: Connect Ventures is a thesis-led European seed VC specialised in product-led software companies. The firm’s investment lens is anchored in a clear product philosophy—backing “opinionated products, crafted with love and loved by many”—and it uses this as a practical framework to evaluate founders, product quality, user outcomes, and the scalability of go-to-market dynamics. Connect’s approach is designed for early conviction and high-touch partnership at the seed stage, with a strong emphasis on the craft of product building and the measurable signals of “product love” (retention, engagement, referral behaviour, and other category-appropriate usage KPIs). The firm has historically backed a range of defining European product companies, reflecting a consistent focus on teams that can build enduring product advantage and compound it over time.

name: Contactlab
description: ContactLab is Italy’s market leader in the field of direct digital marketing. The company has developed its own SaaS platform for managing and sending e-mail campaigns, sms and push notifications. The platform also integrates exclusive outbound messaging services to maximise customer engagement. Contactlab provides advanced solutions for engaging marketing platforms for commerce-focused companies and fashion & luxury brands. Thanks to its proprietary PaaS technology and the expertise of its team, Contactlab enables brands to receive insights relating to the context of each individual customer in order to make the retail experience more incisive and interesting, while creating a highly individualized, personal and multichanneled experience.

name: Cortilia
description: Cortilia is the first Italian online agricultural marketplace where you can buy short chain products directly from farmers. It connects farmers and consumers and arranges the delivery of fresh, seasonal and sustainable products to customer’s doorsteps. On Cortilia, customers can access a wide range of products, such as meat, fish, fresh cheese, pasta, milk, eggs, bread, jams, wine and craft beer, beauty and household cleaning products, as well as seasonal fruits and vegetables. Cortilia wants to meet the needs of all those people interested in quality, and sustainable shopping. The service is easily customizable and efficient and allows next day delivery.

name: Cosmico
description: Cosmico is a platform that connects organizations with highly specialized talent worldwide, focusing on the future of work. It provides businesses with access to a global pool of freelancers and skilled professionals, offering flexible work arrangements that prioritize freedom, connection, and personal fulfillment. Cosmico fosters a talent-driven work environment, helping companies innovate through top-tier talent while empowering individuals to take ownership of their projects and careers.

name: Cyber Guru
description: Cyber Guru’s mission is to increase employee knowledge around information security. Despite the advancements in cybersecurity technology, the “human factor” is still one of the primary vectors used by cybercriminals to attack an organisation. Some of the most common human errors that lead to data breaches include falling victim to phishing scams, providing unauthorised access to corporate devices, and poor password protection. As more organisations shift to remote work and full-scale cloud infrastructures, the need to educate employees on cybersecurity and social engineering attack techniques has become a top priority. Cyber Guru’s training and awareness platform strengthens the human factor, converting it from a weak link in an organisation’s defence chain against cybercriminals to the first line of protection. Organisations working with Cyber Guru have reported a 400% or more improvement in phishing resilience after only ten months of use.

name: DataKrypto
description: DataKrypto is an international company with strong Italian roots that specializes in cloud encryption. The company's unique mission is to protect strategic data, a goal it has pursued for over two decades. Through extensive research and development efforts devoted to homomorphic encryption algorithms, DataKrypto has developed an innovative and effective level of protection called "Encryption in Process". One of the company's key offerings is the DataKrypto Cloud (DK Cloud) system. This system encrypts data in a way that allows applications to perform searches and operations without a decryption key. The proprietary algorithm used in DK Cloud enables fast encryption, searches on encrypted data, searches on full and partial strings, and allows for math operations. It is highly scalable and efficient. DK Cloud is available as an SDK or as an ODBC/JDBC driver.

name: DayBreakHotels
description: DayBreakHotels is an online timely-based hotel booking platform for the day time. It enables travellers to find & book hotel rooms, meeting rooms, SPAs & swimming pools via the platform by making an online payment. Their app is available for iOS & Android devices.

name: Deporvillage
description: Deporvillage is an online retailer offering sports goods and accessories. It aims at becoming the reference space for all athletes looking for the best brands, by providing its customers with the broadest assortment of sports goods at competitive prices and an outstanding customer service.

name: FATMAP
description: FATMAP is the outdoor adventure platform for web and mobile. Wherever your inspiration takes you, you’ll be ready for any adventure. From those late-night planning sessions to those early morning summits. With the world’s first global 3D map specifically designed for the outdoors, you can create, plan and share every adventure life brings you. Built with best data, world-leading 3D technology and available for free on the web and for mobiles, your journey can always start with FATMAP.

name: Forcemanager
description: Founded in 2011, ForceManager is shaping the way in which field sales teams work, making the process more agile and less time consuming for sales representatives, while providing better information and real-time data to managers. ForceManager is dedicated to create the best mobile-CRM for field sales teams, with versatile product features and AI capabilities. ForceManager is transforming and advancing CRMs into personal sales assistants.

name: Gourmant
description: Gourmant is an ecommerce for food lovers. Through flash-sales events, its members can buy excellent Italian food products at affordable prices. Gourmant’s team carefully selects the finest craftsmen, in order to satisfy even the most discerning customers by offering the best quality food products on the market. An e-commerce for all food lovers and for all those who are curios to try out new niche products, which are usually offered at 50%, 40%, or – more rarely - 30% discount. Among the products: sweets, spirits, craft beers, mushrooms and truffles, oils and vinegars, meats and cheeses, and various types of salts and spices.

name: Habacus
description: Habacus is a forward-thinking platform dedicated to revolutionizing access to education financing. By leveraging innovative technology, Habacus provides students with tailored financial solutions to help fund their studies and achieve their academic goals. The platform combines personalized funding opportunities, performance tracking, and data-driven insights to empower students, making higher education more accessible and inclusive. Habacus bridges the gap between education and financial institutions, fostering a supportive ecosystem for student success and long-term impact.

name: Habyt
description: Habyt aims at creating the housing concept of the future, by providing a network of co-living spaces in the main cities of the world, while hosting tech-savvy millennials that add value to the community. The idea is simple: design a new standard of living spaces that combine superior comfort with cutting-edge design; curate a community of like-minded individuals that will populate it; integrate seamless technology that facilitates the rental experience, and allows communication between guests and community managers.

name: Hotiday
description: Hotiday is an Italian traveltech startup founded in 2022 that partners with independent hotels across Europe to create curated “Room Collections” designed for modern travelers. By using proprietary technology to identify and enhance underutilized rooms, Hotiday delivers a consistent, high-quality experience while boosting hotel occupancy and revenue. Guests benefit from 24/7 digital concierge services via WhatsApp, offering local tips and seamless support. Active in over 70 destinations and having hosted 40,000+ guests, Hotiday is redefining hospitality through a decentralized, tech-enabled model that combines authentic stays with smart convenience.

name: Incapto
description: Incapto is a specialty coffee company dedicated to delivering a premium coffee experience like no other. With a deep passion for the art of coffee roasting and a commitment to sourcing the finest beans from around the world, Incapto is known for its exquisite, handcrafted brews that cater to the most discerning coffee enthusiasts. Every cup of Incapto is a testament to their dedication to quality, sustainability, and the pursuit of the perfect coffee flavor. Incapto is a certified B Corporation with an Impact Business Model, which is designed to create a specific positive outcome for one of its stakeholders, such as workers or the community.

name: Join Capital
description: Join Capital is an early-stage venture capital firm focused on European deep tech that strengthens the backbone of modern economies—enterprise, industry, and defence. The team invests in technologies built for durability and strategic relevance, prioritising real intellectual property and clear differentiation versus legacy systems. Their approach is explicitly long-term: they aim to stay close to founders from the first institutional check through scale, helping translate hard technology into meaningful adoption and impact. From an investment perspective, Join Capital targets pre-seed through Series A, typically investing €1–5 million, and looks for tangible technical maturity (minimum TRL 4) supported by early user or customer feedback. The firm operates across major European hubs (Berlin, London, Milan), reflecting a cross-border sourcing and scaling mindset aligned with the pan-European nature of deep tech commercialisation.

name: Keyless
description: Keyless is a deep-tech cybersecurity company building the world’s first privacy-preserving biometric authentication and personal identity management platform. Keyless Zero-Knowledge Biometric (ZKB™) solutions provide passwordless multi-factor authentication that eliminates fraud, phishing, and credential reuse – all while enhancing customer and employee experiences and protecting their privacy. With Keyless, businesses are finally able to adopt zero-trust security, eliminate passwords, ensure privacy compliance and deliver unified authentication experiences across every touchpoint.

name: Libracyber
description: LibraCyber is a European human-centric cybersecurity company, formed from the strategic combination of Libraesva and Cyber Guru. Its mission is to help IT and security teams protect their organization and its people from cyber threats — the privacy-first way. LibraCyber is the only European vendor with international scale that combines privacy-first, AI-powered email security with security awareness training in a sovereign Human Risk Management platform. The company serves more than 3,500 customers globally through a network of over 500 resellers and managed service providers

name: Loquis
description: Loquis is a geo-podcasting platform that provides information about places all over the world through geolocated podcasts. The platform serves both B2C and B2B spaces in the Travel and Hospitality Tech market segments. Loquis allows users to listen to and publish geo-localized podcasts, providing an immersive travel experience. The platform features stories about places, buildings, monuments, street art works, famous film locations, historical events, excursions and itineraries, clubs and restaurants, legends, and anecdotes. It also offers a navigator function that tells users about the places around them. Loquis also provides an opportunity for businesses to promote and market their products or services using the app. It adopts an "open access publishing" model, giving institutions, corporations, and individuals the opportunity to disseminate tailored content in the desired language to different travelers.

name: Mama Health
description: Mama Health’s technology works by collecting experiences directly from people and organizing them with its process mining algorithms. The output is a model that educates individuals and informs healthcare organizations on the most urgent patient needs. We stand for empowering patients through crowdsourced information and peer-to-peer support, while progressing medical research.

name: Milkman
description: Milkman Technologies offers a Last Mile recipient-centric cloud solution that empowers Logistics and Retailer organizations to increase Revenues and Profitability thanks to convenient, cost-effective, and sustainable delivery options. Based on AI-powered algorithms, the Platform connects recipients’ and businesses' needs, eliminating unfeasible deliveries and reducing operational expenditures. Businesses can modulate their level of service, incentivizing wider slots for better distributed, more efficient, and greener services and preventing broken promises as well as delighting even the most demanding recipients with very precise appointments at low marginal cost.

name: Misiedo
description: MiSiedo provides online real-time reservations at the best Italian restaurants. The service allows users to consult the availability of a restaurant at any time and to receive an immediate confirmation of their reservation on their desktop or mobile device. MiSiedo was born in 2011 from the partnership between 2night and H-Farm with the mission of facilitating the management of reservations for restaurateurs by providing an easy to access digital application (Erb for iPad, thus allowing for the first time real-time online reservations.

name: Multiply Labs
description: Multiply Labs has developed personalized capsules that contain a variety of supplements, with the ideal dosage for each individual which are released over a specific time-period for prolonged therapeutic effects. Multiply Labs was founded to provide individuals the freedom to customize their intake of supplements to optimize their daily needs. Using patent-pending release technology developed at MIT and the University of Milan, Multiply Labs wants to revolutionize the perception around the supplement industry.

name: Mundimoto
description: Mundimoto is the leading i-buyer in the motorbike category. Users can search bikes by categories, view their specifications & price, calculate finance, see offers & place orders via the platform by making an online payment. It also provides vehicle appraisal, customized financing plans & more. Our mission is to transform the way people buy their next motorbike in Europe. We realised that while people love riding their motorbikes, they don’t always enjoy the process of buying or selling them. So we are creating a totally new way, providing transparency, convenience and peace of mind. We allow customers to browse, finance and purchase more than 1.000 motorbikes on the go via their mobile device, while also offering the convenience of selling your motorbike to us without ever having to step foot inside a dealership.

name: Musement
description: Musement helps travellers enjoy in-destination experiences to the fullest, sourcing local knowledge and recommendations to make the best use of time. Whether it’s activities, tours, tickets or just ideas for a great night out, Musement allows easy and secure bookings through Musement.com and their app (available bot for iOS and Android).

name: Musixmatch
description: With more than 70 million people using Musixmatch worldwide, the platform has become the most popular lyrics destination for mobile devices. Musixmatch’s lyrics catalogue is created, synched, and translated through its community and validated by a team of international supervisors. Users can connect Musixmatch with Spotify, Apple Music, and dozens of other music services.

name: Mymenu
description: MyMenu is a delivery service that enables customers to place orders from the best restaurants and have them delivered wherever they are in an average of 30 minutes. Mymenu was born from the idea of a few young entrepreneurs with a strong passion for food and the digital world. Their goal is to transform Mymenu into a reference point for quality food delivery in Italy. They are committed to Italianness, uniqueness and digitization, always trying to be one step ahead by selecting only the best restaurants for their customers.

name: Octorate
description: Octorate provides a SaaS-based hospitality booking management and sales optimization platform which is currently used by over 7,000 customers, such as hotels, b&bs, farms, and houses. The solution features a centralized calendar to manage presences, prices, availability to improve decision making processes and increase sales.

name: Opyn
description: Opyn is the first fintech platform that makes access to business loans easy and quick for small and medium companies and simplifies the work of banks. Founded in 2012 as an online loan broker, thanks to a proprietary, highly innovative and paperless technology, Opyn has grown exponentially. Today it offers, on one hand, loans to Italian SMEs in just a few days and, on the other hand, its software-asa- service to financial institutions and corporates that want to support their customers and give them fast and smart loans through artificial intelligence and machine learning.

name: Osteocom
description: Osteocom was born as a blog and has rapidly evolved into a leader digital communication platform for the dental sector, specialised in education services, through a video platform and collaboration with some of the most famous experts and professionals. The company has developed a proprietary solution that offers a versified range of services: from subscription to innovative, efficient, and user-friendly video courses held by the best professionals, to B2B web communication services for companies and associations in the dental sector.

name: Quadro
description: Quadro is a smart controller for your Mac and Windows computer, a new paradigm in desktop interaction. Its purpose is to simplify and empower computing tasks, streamline the workflow to help stay focused and be more productive. Quadro has been primarily designed for digital creatives: musicians and designers. Their product facilitates creative workers’ approach to computers, letting them work within their creative flow, eliminating all that is unnecessary and distracts them from focussing on their creations. Quadro allows them to control the most used softwares such as Photoshop or Ableton, with a simple tap, on their tablets and smartphones.

name: Sellf
description: Sellf is a mobile app for CRM that simplifies the management of business opportunities and customer relations. Sellf collects all relevant details on contacts, todos, emails, and appointments, to provide a complete and upto- date overview of sales activities. Sellf remembers activities and arrangements, monitors results, allows you to make quick decisions and easily understand where to focus. It collects data automatically, hence it minimizes the effort of entering data. It is a productivity app with the power of an innovative CRM, which allows you to dynamically manage relationship activities with customers and your professional activity.

name: Shoppable
description: Shoppable is an online shop for design, style and home products. The team of cool product hunters scouts for a careful selection of beautiful, yet unconventional artifacts. Shoppable is dedicated to people who want to find something original every day to enrich their style and their home. Every day, Juliette Bellavita and her team select the most interesting brands, the most creative designers and the most particular products to offer a well-balanced mix of Nordic Design, French Touch and Asian minimalism.

name: Sift
description: Sift provides fraud prevention solutions for payments. Its product offered to businesses include Digital Trust and Safety suite which protects businesses from account takeover, payment fraud, and scam content from destroying the brand’s integrity. It provides solutions for fintech, retail, food and beverage, and more.

name: Silicon Roundabout Ventures
description: Silicon Roundabout Ventures is a community-driven venture capital firm backing exceptional deep tech founders at pre-seed and seed across Europe. Its positioning is built around technical conviction and early access: the firm leverages a large, long-standing community of engineers and builders to meet companies before they are broadly visible, then supports them through the earliest institutional stages where specialist evaluation and founder support can be decisive. The fund focuses on foundational, high-leverage technologies in critical domains such as computing, defence, and energy. Its community platform—reported as 15,000+ entrepreneurs and engineers—has historically acted as both a sourcing engine and a filtering mechanism for deep tech and big data startups, reinforcing a differentiated funnel and an operator-to-investor feedback loop.

name: Snap
description: Snap is a mobile marketplace for buying and selling secondhand goods. Snap is the application that helps you sell objects on your smartphone through the use of photography alone. A quick app for those with little time that is based on the fact that one picture is worth a thousand words. The sale is concluded without physical contact through integrated tools such as a chat connects seller buyer. Payments can be made directly within the app and shipments can be tracked.

name: Soplaya
description: Soplaya is the digital marketplace where Chefs buy goods directly from the Producers, at the best possible price, without intermediaries, and have them delivered daily where they want (i.e. restaurants, hotel, bar, patisserie, etc.). They revolutionize the supply chain by bringing transparency and simplicity to the sourcing phase, increasing order frequency, streamlining inventory and reducing food waste.

name: Startupitalia
description: StartupItalia is an Italian website for startup news, events, and information. It tracks and covers startups, venture funds & investors, and events across Italy. Startupitalia! was founded in 2013 to shed a light on the world of startups and create a favourable environment for the development of solid and competitive companies. Startupitalia! aims at creating a virtuous circle that includes: the largest Italian network of innovation events with international visibility and participants, a digital hub, innovative companies, investors and professionals, a material place where startups and consolidated companies can be together, share good practices and develop open innovation projects.

name: Strava
description: Strava is the leading subscription platform at the center of connected fitness, with more than 100 million active people in 195 countries. The platform offers a holistic view of your active lifestyle, no matter where you live, which sport you love and/or what device you use. Everyone belongs on Strava when they are pursuing an active life. Join the community, find motivation and discover new experiences with a Strava subscription.

name: Streetbeat
description: Streetbeat is a fintech company that offers an AI-driven investment platform and app. The platform serves as a personalized investment advisor, allowing users to create their own investment strategies by leveraging generative AI. Streetbeat offers personalized investment portfolios that align with users' unique investment goals and risk appetite. The company employs several market-leading partners, including Alpaca Markets, Plaid, and Onfido, to enhance security and instill confidence. The company is an SEC-registered investment adviser.

name: Swite
description: Swite is a platform that allows users to create a personal website from the content they have already published on their social networks, by directly connecting their accounts. The website, is automatically updated as soon as users share new content. With Swite everyone can create their own website with a simple click, connecting their social networks and transforming the published content into a Social Website that shows the best of their online activity. Thanks to a section dedicated to content management, it allows to update content both automatically and manually, thus offering greater control over user privacy. Users can also create more than one swite, or create a swite starting from a Facebook page, which allows small businesses to promote their business to a larger audience.

name: Tannico
description: Tannico is the ecommerce dedicated to wine lovers. Every day Tannico carefully select the best Italian and foreign cellars through the help of a team of dedicated sommeliers. Tannico was born at the end of 2012 with the aim of becoming the first e-wine shop on the market and has successfully accomplished its goal. It has an extraordinarily wide catalogue, a stock of over 100,000 bottles and an exceptional delivery service – orders are delivered in 24/48 hours in Italy and in one day within the city of Milan. Tannico also launched an area dedicated to Small Producers to help smaller Italian companies that make excellent wine but find it difficult to access the distribution market.

name: Teiacare
description: Teiacare is a digital health company leveraging artificial intelligence to improve care delivery in long-term care facilities. Its platform provides real-time monitoring of residents, enabling care teams to detect risks early, respond more quickly, and optimize daily operations. By combining unobtrusive sensing technology with advanced data analytics, Teiacare transforms behavioral data into actionable insights. This helps reduce adverse events, improve staff efficiency, and enhance the overall quality of care. The company addresses a critical need in an aging society, supporting care providers in delivering safer, more proactive, and more scalable care.

name: Toduba
description: Toduba is a fintech startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in Turin, Italy. The company operates in the corporate welfare and digital payments industry, offering innovative solutions for managing employee benefits. Toduba provides a fully digital, secure, and customizable platform that allows companies to distribute meal vouchers, shopping vouchers, fringe benefits, and flexible benefits through a mobile app and digital wallet. By replacing traditional paper-based or card-based systems, Toduba simplifies the management of corporate welfare, reduces administrative burdens, and ensures greater transparency and regulatory compliance. Its value proposition lies in creating a more efficient, flexible, and sustainable ecosystem for both companies and employees, helping businesses save costs while enhancing employee satisfaction.

name: Unguess
description: UNGUESS is the tech-platform to bring collective wisdom in your company’s decision-making processes at speed and at any time needed. Unleashing the power of our highly vetted crowd of thousands of engaged humans, this solution provides a “fresh-eye” effect, to find answers and to share insightful feedbacks. Three powerhouses fuel UNGUESS: the technology (a flexible and easy-to-use platform), the people (the vast community of real people and the UNGUESS team itself) and the methodology (fast, effective, and consistent solutions). The platform offers solutions in four areas: Software Quality, UX/UI Research, CX Research and Insights and Cybersecurity.

name: Velasca
description: Velasca is a digital native high-quality footwear and fashion brand. Launched in Italy, it is now present in the US and throughout Europe with both digital and brick & mortar channels. Velasca's innovative business model allows to offer its customers high quality, Made in Italy fashion at affordable prices. Velasca represents the change of paradigm in fashion and in the 2.0 economy, where style meets innovation.

name: Viralize
description: Viralize is a technological platform that unites online Publishers, Video Creators and Advertisers. With their hub and technology stack, publishers distribute top video content while optimizing ad revenue, creators get exposure for their quality videos and advertisers connect to their next engaged customer. Viralize was founded in Florence, Italy and has offices in New York, London, Milan, Rome, and Madrid.

name: Waynaut
description: Waynaut provides multimodal directions comprising of transportation, from the subway to carpooling on a single platform. Also, provides Multimodal directions as a Service wherein website or app can show their users the best way to get where they need, from door to door, using traditional and innovative means of transportation. Charges fee to integrate the multimodal routing power.

name: Web3 Pro
description: Web3 Pro is a B2B SaaS platform that offers enterprise-grade applications for marketing, gaming, and record authentication. The company provides a white-label platform that enables global brands to create seamless and on-brand NFT campaigns. Web3 Pro's Hub Marketing Engagement Platform offers tools for gated content, loyalty programs, and community building to help businesses engage, incentivize, retain, and grow their customer base and ROI without using cookies. The company's solutions include enterprise-grade Web3 SDKs and low-code solutions. The company is also involved in the intersection of art, AI, and blockchain, exploring new frontiers for creative ownership.

name: WeSchool
description: WeSchool’s mission is the digitization of the Italian school system. They help teachers learn new teaching methods and work with companies on projects that bring value to the world of education. With WeSchool Professors can bring their classes online and make their teaching digital. WeSchool helps students too: with more than 15,000 hours of training provided every day, WeSchool Library is one of the biggest cultural dissemination projects in Italy.

name: Wiman
description: wiMAN has developed a technology that helps small business owners to increase social media presence through a Wi-Fi router. Customers can login to Wi-Fi via Facebook or Google. In 2015, they have launched a mobile app to allow customers to automatically find the best Wi-Fi around and connect based on the network conditions.

name: Wonderflow
description: Wonderflow is Europe’s leading provider of consumer feedback analysis. Operating globally, the company is changing how enterprises manage text analytics processes. In the last years, Wonderflow has helped several brands to become consumer-centric and more successful in their respective markets. The list of customers includes Philips, Samsung, Tomtom, Uber, Reckitt Benckiser, Beiersdorf, DHL, Kantar, AT Kearney, TUI and Estée Lauder.

name: Altstore
description: Different kind of app store

name: 10-4 AI
description: The AI employee for fleet maintenance 10-4 are building the AI employee for fleet maintenance. They bring together a fleet’s scattered data, turn it into clear priorities, and automate the work that follows, all from the channels teams already use every day, like email and WhatsApp. Their mission is to help fleets spend less, recover the money that slips through the cracks, and grow without growing overhead. Because no two fleets operate the same way, they work as a forward-deployed team, adapting 10-4 to how each fleet actually runs.

name: AgroLeague
description: Connecting farmers to share key knowledge. AgroLeague aim to engineer sustainable agricultural systems that blend profitability and ecological stewardship, impacting millions of farmers worldwide. Their platform connects farmers, diagnoses farming issues, and offers the necessary services to transition to regenerative farming through state-of-the-art techniques.

name: Amini
description: Bridging environmental data in the Global South. Amini build African environmental data collection and intelligence infrastructures to provide a plug-and-play solution purpose-built for challenging last-mile environments where trust is expensive. Their vertically integrated data platform provides trusted, actionable, and low-cost data at the last mile. Amini's mission is to build the single source of truth for environmental data in the Global South and enable the resilience of 1 billion people by 2030.

name: Arctal
description: The last data source you'll need. Arctal's AI agents ingest documents at scale and output structured, validated datasets across transition and climate risk, sovereign and country-level data, and credit and fixed income. Coverage updates continuously as new documents are published with no refresh cycles or manual processing. Documents in, validated datasets out, with expert human oversight where it matters.

name: Atlas
description: Redefining maps for a changing world. Atlas redefine how people work with maps and geospatial data, making it simple, powerful, and accessible. The browser-based platform eliminates the need for downloads or complicated software, providing intuitive tools to visualise, analyse, and share location data effortlessly. Atlas’ mission is to empower teams across industries — from renewable energy to urban planning, real estate, and conservation — to make smarter, data-driven decisions. Whether it’s mapping biodiversity or planning sustainable cities, Atlas help users address global challenges with speed and collaboration.

name: Bettaf!sh
description: Making seaweed an integral part of our food system. BettaF!sh were created to offer the most authentic tuna alternative out there. They combine European seaweed with a high-tech solution to save one of the world's most widely consumed but damaging species: tuna. BettaF!sh have developed deep expertise with algae following the launch of their first algae-based product, Oceanfruit, which offers seaweed products carefully paired with Western flavour profiles. BettaF!sh positively impact the whole supply chain by allowing the oceans to recover, create alternative income opportunities for fishing communities, and provide tasty, high-protein food: a win-win solution for all.

name: Brineworks
description: Decarbonising with electrochemistry: Brineworks' proprietary breakthrough electrolyser enables the low-cost extraction of CO₂ through Direct Air Capture and the co-production of H₂, the two building blocks of e-fuels. Their mission is to help rapidly decarbonise sectors like aviation and maritime by harnessing the power of cutting-edge electrochemistry.

name: Care Weather
description: Solving for data shortages. Data shortages are the foremost barrier to adapting to extreme weather caused by climate change, and unfortunately, there aren't enough weather satellites to keep up with it. Care Weather collect weather data using their unique flat-panel radar satellite. It is more cost-effective than alternatives because it's vertically integrated, gets more solar power, and sails on top of the atmosphere for a closer surface view. With abundant, high-accuracy data, Care Weather will save lives and livelihoods from extreme weather.

name: CBAMBOO
description: The operating system for carbon border taxes. CBAMBOO aim to accelerate industry decarbonisation by helping companies understand and optimise their carbon border taxes. The CBAMBOO platform connects decision-makers with their supply chain to track and minimise embedded carbon emissions. It is further designed to help firms integrate product-based carbon prices into every purchasing decision. Industries such as steelmaking and auto supplies can join CBAMBOO to comply with CBAM.

name: Cinqo
description: Waste mutualisation, unlocking savings and ESG. Cinqo operate and mutualise waste management for industrial and tertiary sites to structurally reduce costs while improving ESG performance. As a hands-on operator, they pool waste volumes across multiple sites to massify flows, renegotiate contracts, and optimise collections and recycling. Their operations are augmented by a data platform ensuring traceability, ISO compliance, and auditable ESG reporting. Their mission is to turn fragmented waste management into a collective lever for cost savings and environmental impact.

name: Cirplus
description: Digital procurement services for circular plastics. Cirplus connect recyclers, compounders, plastic converters, and brand owners. By lowering the transactional costs for recycled plastics, they catalyse the industry shift away from virgin material wherever feasible, saving up to 80% of CO² emissions per ton replaced. They are also a global leader in circular plastic standardisation, initiating, financing, and publishing DIN SPEC 91446, the world’s first standard for high-quality plastic recycling and digitisation, and the follow-up DIN SPEC 91481.

name: Climate X
description: Enabling a climate resilient future. Climate X’s online platform and APIs enable governments and businesses to analyse and build resilience for climate-change-related risks. They do this by delivering location-specific risk ratings and loss estimates for extreme weather events linked to climate change. Climate X cover all hazard types, including flooding, subsidence, and landslides. Climate risk is a top priority for the future, with new regulations meaning companies need to urgently understand how climate change impacts their businesses, including portfolio management, pricing, lending decisions, and more. Companies are missing the data required to do this, and Climate X provide the solution. Prospective clients and the world’s biggest consulting groups regularly benchmark Climate X as the best-in-market solution.

name: Cosmic Aerospace
description: Manufacturing electric aircraft with range. Cosmic Aerospace achieve this through a novel clean-sheet aircraft design that tightly integrates the propulsion system design, aircraft structures, and aerodynamics design to unlock an aircraft configuration with aerodynamic efficiency and lightweight structure. By focusing on developing highly efficient airframes and propulsion systems, they aim to build aircraft that can cover 50% of the aviation market by range with the batteries that are available today.

name: Distill
description: Leveraging uncertainty for better decisions. Distill simulate thousands of hypothetical futures for the power grid to help investors, traders, renewable developers, and grid operators understand the risk associated with their assets. They handle the complexity by weaving AI, machine learning, and physics together with market regulations, economics, and policy -- users experience a clean and intuitive interface with uncertainty-aware forecasts. Distill have observed that a better understanding of risk drives increased return on capital, making renewables more profitable and easier to lend against. Distill accelerate that transition.

name: Ember
description: Accelerating the electric transition. Ember's goal is to replace the private car with a better alternative, making the whole journey from A to B seamless. Their full-stack platform powers the operations, the charging infrastructure, and the entire customer experience. As a result, they're running the highest-mileage EVs in the world on the most demanding routes.

name: Green-Got
description: Changing your bank to change the world. Green-Got are a neobank combining the best banking and investment technology for climate and planet protection. They offer investment opportunities in emerging technologies and companies that will be tomorrow’s champions. Users can effortlessly fund impact-driven projects with every purchase and round up their payments to support nonprofit organisations. All impacts can be tracked in real time directly through the app.

name: Hack Your Closet
description: Extending your closet, without costing the earth. Hack Your Closet came from the belief that fashion can benefit everyone: the customers, the retailers, and the environment. Unused garments have become a real issue in the apparel industry, but if solved, they can radically reduce carbon footprints. They were a clothing subscription service that gave customers more and did more to help the environment. Customers created a style profile and received a data-driven personalised box of clothing delivered to their doorstep every month — a monthly discovery that didn't cost the earth.

name: Hier Foods
description: Decentralising the food system. Hier shaped the future of our food system, providing a future-proof alternative to the increasingly disrupted global food supply chain by connecting digital and brick-and-mortar food retailers with local suppliers through a state-of-the-art platform. Their platform connected to existing systems through industry-standard EDI or a new API while equipping players with lower digitalisation levels with easy-to-use software. Uniquely combining any retailer or supplier, Hier’s approach reimagined how food is procured, ultimately making our food supply more resilient, less wasteful, and higher quality.

name: HIVED
description: Delivering parcels for the 21st century. HIVED build the most efficient, versatile, and environmentally friendly infrastructure for moving goods in and out of addresses in the Western World — all by leveraging process innovation, software, data, and vertical integration. They are more efficient (therefore more affordable) and better for the environment, being 100% emission-free — all while providing a 10X better delivery experience.

name: Improvin'
description: Focusing on primary production. Improvin' exist to solve one of the food industry’s most complex problems: producing more food more sustainably with limited resources. Their solution focuses on primary production, the source of 70% of the industry’s emissions. With the Improvin' digital infrastructure, companies can incorporate sustainability into their existing sourcing processes and report with integrity using primary data.

name: Infyos
description: Enabling every battery to be sustainable. Knowing what improvements to implement is challenging in this complex and quickly evolving landscape. Infyos aim to build a future where every battery is sustainable by combining their deep domain knowledge with their leading software to bring sustainability expertise to the next generation of battery players.

name: Jane Energy
description: Energy intelligence for every property. Jane provide AI-powered energy intelligence for commercial real estate. Their platform integrates utility bills, interval data, and property data to create reliable energy visibility across entire portfolios. Using automated analysis and DOE-backed modeling, Jane continuously surfaces high-ROI savings opportunities – from rate optimization to operational improvements and capital projects. By turning fragmented energy data into actionable insights, Jane helps real estate owners reduce costs, improve performance, and unlock NOI across every property.

name: JaroFleet
description: Accelerating freight truck electrification. Founded by an experienced electric vehicle expert, Jaro Fleet are deploying a first-in-class charging technology and highly scalable customer acquisition model to electrify the fastest-growing segment of US freight trucking. Their solutions solve critical near-term adoption barriers and enable fleet cost savings when deployed at scale. Replacing diesel trucks with electric ones will cut US GHG emissions by about 5% and eliminate one of the primary sources of harmful urban air pollution. Jaro Fleet are structured as a Public-benefit Corporation to centre their mission and empower their team to do their best work in service of the climate.

name: Juice
description: Every second counts. Juice is building the invisible layer that makes every vehicle-stop faster, smarter and easier. They operate a marketplace that connects drivers and fleets to parking operators, charging networks, toll providers and car wash facilities through one vehicle-first experience. Powered by proprietary computer vision, Juice identify vehicles, automate payments and deliver security and fleet insights – all without apps, cards or manual processes. Currently, Juice services are available in Sweden. The company also deploys fully funded Tesla-powered “Juice Bars" with site hosts.

name: Maiven
description: Simplifying policy so you can act with confidence. In the last 15 years, companies have faced an average of 54 new climate policies each year. This constant influx of regulations can leave businesses overwhelmed and exposed to both risks and missed opportunities. At Maiven, they cut through the complexity. Their platform delivers tailored, real-time insights that help you pinpoint the most relevant climate policies, understand their implications, and take decisive actions to mitigate climate risks and capture business opportunities.

name: Monta
description: Making EV charging globally accessible. Monta's software solves the pains of both EV drivers and charge point owners. Through their web platform, Monta’s charge point management system provides charge point owners with a solution to attract users and manage charge point use, pricing, access, and transactions. For EV drivers, Monta provide reservation, virtual queuing, and payment features under one platform and unlock public charge points to reduce the risk of drivers being caught out of range.

name: Nala
description: Making nature and biodiversity manageable. Nala’s platform and APIs enable businesses to make the complex world of nature and biodiversity manageable. Through their global nature data layer, businesses gain visibility into the intactness of the natural world at the local level. Moreover, the platform allows users to measure how different activities impact and depend on water, land, and biodiversity, allowing for a comprehensive nature assessment complying with upcoming reporting requirements. Nature management is a top priority for the future. And Nala provide the solution.

name: Opna
description: Investing in meaningful climate action. Opna revolutionise developers' access to capital, making carbon credit investment easier and more secure while boosting inclusive financing for real-world impact. Through long-term procurement agreements, they pool and optimise carbon budgets, allocate funds to impactful projects, and provide ongoing risk management and portfolio oversight.

name: Overstory
description: Creating vegetation intelligence at scale. Vegetation is the single greatest contributor to power outages and wildfires caused by our electric grid. Overstory provide utilities with visibility, risk analysis, and optimisation recommendations for vegetation management throughout the entire service territory. They apply machine learning to satellite imagery to track forests and vegetation, helping reduce the risk of wildfires, power outages, and loss of biodiversity.

name: Paebbl
description: Restoring captured carbon into industrial material. CO² mineralisation is a natural process that turns carbon dioxide into stone – but as with most geological processes, it takes centuries. Based on 20 years of research, Paebbl have found a way to accelerate the process by a factor of more than a million with minimal energy use. They combine captured carbon with abundant minerals to create a carbon-negative raw material. Paebbl’s technology is industrially scalable and can be integrated into any carbon capture system. The resulting carbon-negative raw material stream fundamentally changes the economics of keeping carbon away from our atmosphere.

name: Patch
description: Building the platform for negative emissions. Patch's marketplace enables businesses of all sizes to work with carbon removal projects and neutralise their emissions. By enabling companies to embed carbon removal use cases into their own products and services, such as carbon-neutral shipping, travel, and climate-positive financial services products, Patch is making climate action accessible to people and businesses worldwide. They also enable companies to buy directly from verified carbon removal project developers.

name: Pelikan Mobility
description: Tech-enabled EV leasing for commercial fleets. Pelikan Mobility’s mission is to make fleet electrification cost-effective and operationally seamless. Their smart leasing model combines a digital twin platform that mirrors each customer’s fleet operations, optimising EV integration and performance. Their leasing contracts compete by leveraging EVs' highest-performance mode — longer durations and routes. This approach allows fleets to transition to electric at near-total cost parity with diesel, ensuring financial and operational benefits.

name: Persimmons
description: Built for the next intelligence leap in AI Persimmons' modular chiplet platform packs datacenter-class inference into a coin-sized module that scales from edge devices, such as robots, drones, vehicles, and defence systems, to full rack-scale deployments, and is air-coolable by design, so it drops into existing infrastructure. Founded in 2023 in San Jose, the company taped out V0 silicon in 18 months with a team of ten, led by founders from Recogni, NVIDIA, Apple, Microsoft and Arm.

name: Phytoform
description: Mastering plant genetics to control waste. Phytoform's platform can efficiently and rapidly develop new plant traits, implementing them into crop varieties with minimal genomic changes. They are delivering traits with partners to reduce waste in the tomato and potato supply chains, significantly decreasing inputs and emissions. They are also developing alternative crops to increase the diversity and robustness of the food system.

name: PIONIX
description: Powering e-mobility with open-source. The larger the market and the number of different EVs, chargers, operating systems, firmware, cloud apps, mobile apps, etc., the more complex the software development challenges. This is not surprising, as every EV charger must work with every EV variant and all connected apps and cloud software. PIONIX believe the only possible way to face this combinatorial explosion and build a reliable EV charging infrastructure is an open-source software model. Their software solution EVerest aims to establish a standard for a unified EV ecosystem by eliminating pain points such as compatibility, resource expenditure, and innovation hurdles.

name: Pivotal
description: Leveraging data and analytics for biodiversity. By leveraging technological advances, Pivotal enable scalable, affordable collection, analysis, and reporting of on-the-ground data that tracks changes to biodiversity — real changes to species and habitats, not predictions made from models, proxy data, or global averages. Their data and analytics are quality-controlled and fully auditable. When you: evaluate your biodiversity impacts, make claims about biodiversity outcomes you've achieved, or measure and disclose progress towards biodiversity goals and targets, Pivotal make it possible to prove it.

name: Podero
description: Orchestrating the world's electric devices. Podero offer a software platform for utilities that reduces the energy cost of flexible consumer devices like heat pumps, EVs and chargers, inverters, and home batteries by over 25%. Utilities roll out Podero using their white-label web app or integrating their API into their own apps. They steer devices based on consumers’ PV production, spot electricity prices, and the balancing energy markets. Podero enable utilities to trade the aggregate device power on the energy markets, ensuring a win-win situation for both utilities and consumers. Customers of Podero include E.ON, oekostrom, KELAG, and more.

name: Pollen
description: Power that keeps up with cities on the move Road transportation is a major source of greenhouse gas emissions. While cars go electric, two-wheelers remain stuck: over 97% still run on petrol, pumping out hundreds of millions of tonnes of CO₂ yearly. Electrifying lightweight vehicles is tough. Batteries are expensive, ranges are short, charging takes too long, and incompatible vehicle formats make sharing impossible. This is why Pollen was built. A universal, swappable battery for e-mopeds and lightweight EVs, backed by automated stations where riders swap a drained battery for a full one in seconds. No delays, no hassle, no emissions.

name: SnoFox Sciences
description: Optimising the global cold supply chain. SnoFox Sciences work to optimise the global cold supply chain. Much of the equipment we rely on today to keep goods cold (from the manufacturer to our homes, grocery stores, hospitals, and restaurants) is old and difficult to maintain. Working with the owners and operators of industrial refrigeration equipment, SnoFox Sciences help increase energy efficiency and optimise their maintenance cycles. SnoFox Sciences offer a SaaS service that leverages data from each customer to create bespoke dashboards that allow customers to ensure their refrigeration equipment is running as efficiently and effectively as possible.

name: Solarock
description: Boost autonomy with Solar Self-Consumption. Solarock is dedicated to making solar energy accessible to all. They provide turnkey solar solutions focused on self-consumption, offering tailored services from system sizing to installation, as well as innovative technologies for energy storage and monitoring. Their mission is to empower homes and businesses to reduce their energy bills, maximise sustainability, and achieve greater energy independence. With a commitment to quality and operational excellence, Solarock is reshaping the solar energy market through a locally driven, customer-centric approach.

name: Sphere
description: Getting fossil fuels out of 401(k)s. Over 80% of Americans are worried about climate change, but 99% of Americans with retirement savings don't have the option to avoid investing in fossil fuel companies, and over 80% don't realise they're invested in fossil fuel companies in the first place. Sphere make value-aligned investing available to everyone by offering climate-friendly investment products designed for employer-sponsored retirement savings plans, the primary investment vehicle available to most Americans.

name: Staer
description: Physical AI for Autonomous Mobile Robots Staer provide the spatial intelligence layer for the physical world, which enables autonomous robots to see, map, and reason together. Their team previously built technologies powering Apple's Visual Positioning, Meta's Spatial Mapping, Room Scanning, SceneScript, and Neo4j's graph database infrastructure. Now they're applying that experience to robotics at a global scale, providing a unified spatial intelligence and coordination layer that works across any robot vendor and form factor.

name: Tangible
description: Financial Engineering for Futuristic Engineering Debt markets for hardware are fragmented and manual. Every deal is bespoke, and every company starts from scratch. That inefficiency is expensive. We don’t have time for that. To rebuild manufacturing, infrastructure, and energy security, trillions need to be deployed fast. Equity alone can’t fund it. Debt is the leverage that gives founders scale. But if hardware companies waste months in opaque markets, they are bottlenecked. Tangible standardise the chaos: They help companies get ready, connect them with the right lenders and put their facility management on autopilot. The result? Capital flows faster. Less dilution. More companies scale the tech we need.

name: VARM
description: Decarbonising buildings with insulation. Founded in 2023 by serial founders Christian Gruener and Sebastian Wuerz, VARM plan to insulate one million homes in 10 years. By training new installers and connecting them with homeowners, VARM aim to reduce carbon footprints and enhance energy efficiency across Europe. Their affordable air-gap insulation improves efficacy, reduces installation time and costs, and makes energy-efficient buildings more attainable. VARM connect homeowners with their local workforce of independent insulators while slashing CO² emissions along the way.

name: VEAT
description: Breaking every barrier to truly good food. VEAT offer a network of vending machines that sell plant-based cuisine. The team is on a mission to inspire people to eat better. This is why they collaborate with the local favourite restaurants to offer plant-based, chef-prepared meals and distribute fresh meals when needed most.

name: Way
description: Modern fleet data management. By utilising the Way platform, shippers and commercial fleet operators can obtain, combine and utilise data from their fleet vehicles and operational systems. Smart data sharing enables them to modernise transportation interoperability and achieve full supply-chain emissions reporting visibility. Way builds tools to help everyone stay on top of regulatory requirements.

name: Parable

description: PeerSupport improves healthcare and crisis line efficiency by streamlining patient triage and connecting them to the best support. The company aims to become the default plugin for EMR (electronic medical record) systems and crisis lines software, streamlining the referral process to healthcare practitioners and social support services.

name: Pempem
description: Pempem is a platform to digitize smallholder commodity supply chains. It has introduced a real-time trading platform called Niaga for smallholders, farmers, consumers and the planet.

description: Perceptive Space is a AI software that predicts space weather events in real time that may interfere with various processes across satellite operations, national security, energy, oil and gas, and more.
