name: Intenseye
description: Intenseye is an AI-powered workplace safety platform that uses computer vision on existing cameras to detect hazards in real time. It builds enterprise EHS software, delivering instant alerts, insights, and trend analysis from existing CCTV to reduce injuries and drive a proactive safety culture while protecting worker privacy.

name: Jobber
description: Jobber is the leading software platform for field service management SMBs that streamlines quoting, scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, and payments in one system across web and mobile. Founded in 2011 in Edmonton, Canada.

name: Junction
description: Junction (formerly Vital) is a healthcare infrastructure platform that unifies lab testing and wearable device data through a single API. It streamlines ordering, results, and device connectivity with automated workflows and real-time updates.

name: June
description: June was a product and customer analytics platform for B2B SaaS that delivered auto-generated reports and opinionated templates to help teams understand account-level usage and share insights via Slack and email. In 2025, its founding team joined Amplitude and the standalone product was wound down.

name: Juro
description: Juro is an AI-powered contract automation platform that unifies drafting, review, negotiation, e-signature, and post-signature management. It helps legal and business teams create, agree, and manage contracts end-to-end, integrating with existing tools and serving global customers.

name: Kaiko
description: Kaiko delivers high-quality, regulatory-grade crypto market data, pricing, reference rates, indices, and monitoring tools for institutions, exchanges, and fintechs.

name: Keynua
description: Keynua is a digital identity and e-signature platform that enables businesses to securely sign documents online using video signatures, biometric verification, and identity validation.

name: KISI
description: Kisi is a cloud-based access control and security platform that lets organizations manage doors, credentials, and badges from anywhere via mobile and web. Founded in 2012, it pairs smart readers and controllers with deep integrations to unify physical access with modern IT.

name: Kitchen Stories
description: Kitchen Stories is a Berlin-born digital cooking platform offering step-by-step recipes, HD video tutorials, and smart-appliance integrations to help anyone cook with confidence. Founded in 2013, it was majority-acquired by BSH Home Appliances in 2018.

name: Kreditech
description: Kreditech was a Hamburg-based fintech founded in 2012 that used alternative data and machine-learning credit scoring to provide consumer loans and point-of-sale financing in emerging markets.

name: Laserhub
description: Laserhub is a European digital procurement platform for custom metal and plastic parts, offering instant quotes and reliable delivery via a vetted manufacturing network. Founded in 2017 and based in Stuttgart.

name: Lemoncat
description: Lemoncat was a Berlin-based marketplace for corporate catering, helping companies book curated caterers for meetings and events. Founded in 2016, it was acquired by Rocket Internet’s Caterwings in 2019 and integrated into the B2B Food Group.

name: LessonLeap
description: LessonLeap offered engaging online courses that helped K–6 students build language and communication skills through live, small-group classes. LessonLeap was acquired by Preply, another P9 portfolio company.

name: LIFT
description: LIFT develops HEXA, a single-seat, semi-autonomous electric VTOL classified as an ultralight under FAA Part 103, enabling flight without a pilot’s license.

name: Loom
description: Loom is the leading async video messaging platform for work, letting teams record screen, camera, and mic to share quick, link-based videos that replace meetings and long emails. Point Nine led Loom's seed round in 2017. In 2023, the company was acquired by Atlassian for close to $1B.

name: Lottielab
description: Founded in 2021 in London, Lottielab makes it easy to create, edit, and export Lottie animations for web and mobile. With deep Figma integration, real-time collaboration, and AI-assisted motion (including text-to-animation), it helps teams ship high‑quality animations faster.

name: Madvertise
description: Founded in Berlin in 2008, Madvertise built mobile-first ad solutions for brands and agencies, delivering premium reach and high-impact formats across Europe.

name: Mambu
description: Mambu is a cloud-native, composable core banking platform that enables banks, lenders, and fintechs to build, launch, and scale deposits, lending, and payment products quickly. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Amsterdam, it serves customers worldwide.

name: Mason
description: Mason was a feature-building platform that enabled product teams to design, build, and deploy front-end features together without full app releases. Positioned as “front-end as a service,” the company ceased operations in September 2019.

name: Mavenoid
description: Founded in 2016, Mavenoid builds an AI agent for product support focused on physical products. The platform automates diagnostics and deflection, and escalates to live video assistance when needed, helping companies resolve complex issues faster, prevent unnecessary replacements, and improve customer experience across channels.

name: Mention
description: Mention is a social listening and media monitoring platform that tracks brand, competitor, and industry mentions across social, news, blogs, and the web, with alerts, sentiment, and analytics for PR and marketing teams. Founded in 2012 in Paris, it was acquired by Mynewsdesk in 2018.

name: merXu
description: merXu was a European B2B marketplace for renewable energy and industrial installations, connecting verified sellers with installers and wholesalers to trade PV modules, inverters, heat pumps, batteries, and EV chargers.

name: Metalshub
description: Metalshub is a digital supply chain and trading platform for the metals and mining industry. Based in Düsseldorf, it connects buyers and sellers of metals and ferroalloys with integrated procurement tools, RFQ workflows, and proprietary price indices.

name: Mission Barns
description: Mission Barns develops cultivated pork fat and other animal fat ingredients that make meat alternatives and hybrid products taste and cook like conventional meat. Founded in 2018 in Berkeley, the company became the first to bring cultivated meat to US supermarkets.

name: Moai.cash
description: Moai.cash is a decentralized financial super app on Telegram offering zero-fee transactions, a crypto wallet, and prediction markets.

name: Mokker.ai
description: Mokker.ai is an AI-powered product photography platform that turns simple product shots into studio-quality images. It removes backgrounds, offers customizable scenes and templates, and generates on‑brand visuals for e‑commerce, marketplaces, and ads—without a physical photoshoot.

name: Momox
description: Momox (one of Christoph's angel investments before starting P9) is Europe’s leading re-commerce platform for used books, media, and fashion. Founded in 2004 in Berlin, it buys items online at fixed prices and resells them via storefronts like medimops, extending product lifecycles and promoting circular consumption.

name: NexHealth
description: Founded in 2017, NexHealth streamlines the patient journey—from booking to intake, reminders, and payments—by syncing directly with practice EHRs. The company also provides a universal EHR API, enabling developers to build healthcare apps that integrate across dozens of systems.

name: Odyssey
description: Odyssey is an AI research lab building world models — systems that learn the physics, causality, and dynamics of the real world well enough to generate video you can move through and interact with in real time. Its Odyssey-2 model streams minutes-long, explorable simulations from a single text or image prompt.

name: Oferteo
description: Oferteo is Poland’s largest online marketplace connecting people and companies seeking services with vetted contractors across home, construction, and business categories. The platform generates over 2 million requests annually and helps 700,000+ providers win new customers.

name: Omnea
description: Omnea is an AI-native procurement and supplier relationship management platform that streamlines intake, approvals, and renewals, centralizes supplier data, and automates third‑party risk and performance workflows across systems.

name: Ontruck
description: Ontruck is a European digital road‑freight platform that connects shippers with vetted carriers for full and part‑load palletized goods. Founded in Madrid in 2016, it uses real‑time tracking and route optimization to reduce empty miles, cut CO2, and deliver reliable, cost‑efficient transport across Spain and neighboring markets.

name: Pento
description: Pento is a UK-focused payroll automation platform that lets companies run payroll in minutes with real-time calculations, HMRC and pension integrations, and error-reducing workflows. In 2024, Pento was acquired by HRIS provider HiBob to power native UK payroll within Bob.

name: PersistIQ
description: PersistIQ is a sales engagement and prospecting platform that helps small and mid-sized teams find new customers, personalize multi-channel outreach, and automate tasks across email, calls, and CRM. Acquired by Wishpond in 2021.

name: Petsapp
description: Petsapp is a client communication and payments platform for veterinary clinics, offering SMS and WhatsApp chat, appointment booking, video consults, reminders, and digital payments – helping teams streamline workflows and improve the pet owner experience.

name: PlayPlay
description: PlayPlay is an AI-powered video creation platform that helps marketing and communications teams turn messages into professional, on‑brand videos in minutes – no editing skills required. Templates, brand kits, and automated captions, voiceovers, and translations let teams scale video across channels with consistency.

name: Polar Analytics
description: Polar Analytics is an all-in-one ecommerce analytics platform for Shopify and omnichannel brands, unifying data from storefronts, ad platforms, and other sources into a single source of truth.

name: Pomocni
description: Founded in 2008 around the Niania.pl domain, Pomocni runs six niche platforms that match families with vetted caregivers and home services across Poland. Today, the group is owned by Burda Media Home, part of Burda Media Polska.

name: Poolside
description: Poolside is a frontier lab building the most capable foundation models, agents, and enterprise systems to deploy them, starting with software development. Founded by Eiso Kant (founder of Athenian, a P9 portfolio company) and former GitHub CTO Jason Warner.

name: Preply
description: Preply is a global online language learning marketplace that connects learners with expert tutors for 1-on-1 video lessons, using AI to personalize progress. With 100,000+ tutors across 90+ languages, it serves learners in 180+ countries.

name: Procurify
description: Procurify helps finance and operations teams manage purchasing and AP in one place, with budgets, approvals, vendor management, and smart spend cards that track spend in real time. Its AI-enhanced platform provides end-to-end visibility from request through payment.

name: Procuros
description: Procuros builds an AI-powered B2B Integration Hub for retail and FMCG, unifying EDI, APIs, and supplier portals to exchange orders, delivery notes, and invoices seamlessly with thousands of partners.

name: Project Europe
description: Project Europe is an initiative that brings together leading European founders, operators, and investors to support the next generation of startup builders through community, mentorship, and shared resources.

name: Propertybase
description: One of Christoph's angel investments before P9, Propertybase was a CRM solution specifically for the real estate industry. Acquired by Boston Logic in 2017.

name: Purmeo
description: Purmeo is a Berlin-based nutrition brand offering high-quality supplements – from probiotics to targeted micronutrient complexes – designed to support gut, immune, and everyday wellness.

name: Qlub
description: Qlub provides QR-powered pay-at-table, order-and-pay, and digital menu solutions for restaurants, hotels, and lounges. Diners scan a QR code to view the menu, split and settle the bill in seconds while venues boost table turns, tips, and operational efficiency.

name: Qwilr
description: Qwilr is a modern proposal and quoting platform that turns sales documents into interactive web pages with e‑signature, payments, and detailed analytics, connected to CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot. Founded in Sydney in 2014, it helps B2B teams move faster and win more deals.

name: Recast Systems
description: Recast is a weather technology company building the next generation of cloud seeding. They combine biology, AI weather models, sensing hardware, and flight operations to make weather modification more effective, measurable, and scalable.

name: REKKI
description: REKKI connects restaurants with their suppliers, letting chefs browse products, place and track orders, chat in real time, and handle payments in one place. Suppliers use REKKI to streamline order intake and get paid faster, with AI‑powered tools that reduce errors and bad debt.

name: rekord
description: Rekord is an AI-native platform that enables financial institutions to design, scale, and monitor intelligent decision flows across underwriting, onboarding, compliance, and fraud. It unifies models, data, and policies to operationalize AI with guardrails and real-time observability.

name: Remerge
description: Remerge is a leading demand-side platform (DSP) for high-performing app marketing campaigns. Founded in Berlin in 2014, the company operates globally with a strong privacy-first approach.

name: Reonic
description: Reonic is a vertical software platform for renewable energy installers. By unifying lead capture, system design, simulation, digital proposals, and project management Reonic helps teams sell, size, and deliver solar, storage, and heat pump projects faster and more profitably.

name: rerun
description: Rerun builds the data stack for Physical AI, with an open-source SDK and viewer to log, sync, and visualize multimodal data from robotics and computer vision in real time. Teams use Rerun to debug, explore, and share interactive views locally or at scale.

name: Revolut
description: Revolut is the leading global neobank. Founded in London in 2015, Revolut has become a global financial super app, unifying everyday money management – spend, send, save, invest, and business finances – in a single platform.

name: riskmethods
description: Founded in 2013 in Munich, riskmethods provides supply chain risk management software that continuously monitors global threats, scores supplier exposure, and guides mitigation to keep operations resilient and compliant. The company was acquired by Sphera in 2022.

name: Rizm
description: RIZM's software platform integrates data from production, energy procurement, and infrastructure to algorithmically optimize industrial energy systems. Founded in 2020, RIZM helps manufacturers cut costs, reduce emissions, and stay resilient amid energy market volatility.

name: Rollbox
description: Rollbox built an API-first payroll engine that automated multi-country payroll processing for businesses and platforms. Founded in Spain, it offered developer-friendly integrations to run and reconcile payroll at scale. The company was acquired by Personio in 2019.

name: Roomorama
description: Roomorama was a marketplace for professionally managed vacation and short‑term rentals, offering apartments and homes worldwide with secure, instant bookings. Founded in 2009 by Federico Folcia and Jia En Teo, the company ceased operations in 2017.

name: Rooser
description: Rooser was a B2B seafood marketplace based in Edinburgh, connecting European buyers and suppliers with real-time pricing, quality data, and logistics tools to cut waste and improve transparency.

name: Root Global
description: Root Global builds climate intelligence and an end-to-end platform for agricultural supply chains, enabling food and beverage companies to accurately measure, report, and reduce supply chain emissions based on primary data.

name: samedi
description: Founded in 2008 in Berlin, samedi offers a secure patient engagement and scheduling platform for hospitals and medical practices. Acquired by Meierhofer AG in 2017, samedi was one of Christoph’s angel investments prior to Point Nine.

name: Savedo
description: Savedo was a Berlin-based marketplace for retail investment products, letting savers access competitive term deposits from partner banks across Europe. Acquired by Deposit Solutions in 2017, it was later integrated into the combined Raisin/Deposit Solutions group.

name: Scondoo
description: Scondoo is a Berlin-based cashback app that helps shoppers save on groceries and drugstore purchases: snap a receipt, redeem offers, and get money back across major retailers. Founded in 2012, Scondoo was acquired by UK-based CheckoutSmart in 2017.

name: ScreenCloud
description: ScreenCloud is a cloud-based digital signage platform that lets organizations manage and broadcast content, dashboards, and employee comms to any screen at scale.

name: Sensmore
description: Sensmore pioneers embodied AI and vision-based localization (VLAM) for heavy machinery in mining, construction, and related industries. The company retrofits off-highway vehicles with full-stack autonomy, enabling them to perceive, plan, and operate safely and efficiently in the world’s harshest environments.

name: Sereact
description: Sereact develops VLA AI that acts as a production-ready brain for robots, enabling zero-shot autonomy in real-world warehouses and industrial settings. Its system lets robots see, reason, and manipulate varied items across arms, mobile manipulators, and more.

name: Server Density
description: Server Density was a SaaS platform for monitoring servers, websites, and cloud infrastructure. Founded in 2009 and acquired by StackPath in 2018, Server Density was one of Christoph’s angel investments prior to Point Nine.

name: Shapr3D
description: Shapr3D builds a cross-platform, direct-modeling CAD app for iPad, Mac, Windows, and Apple Vision Pro. It brings precise, touch-friendly modeling to designers and engineers, streamlining sketching, 3D modeling, and drawings, with robust import/export for manufacturing workflows and integration with major CAD formats.

name: Showbie
description: Showbie is a K–12 learning platform used by millions of students and educators to manage classroom workflows, deliver assessments, and provide personalized feedback.

name: Soba
description: Soba is an online multiplayer open world and gaming platform with no-code game-making tools, enabling anyone to build, share, and play 3D games across devices.

name: Soda
description: Soda is a data quality and observability platform that helps data and AI teams test, monitor, and prevent issues across pipelines in real time. Built for modern data stacks, Soda blends automated checks with collaborative workflows to deliver trusted, production-grade data.

name: Solarize
description: Solarize provides a modular software platform that orchestrates EV charging, photovoltaic generation, batteries, and dynamic tariffs across properties and fleets. Utilities, real estate operators, and EPCs use it to optimize energy flows and automate metering, billing, and load management.

name: Spacebase
description: Spacebase is a booking platform for workshop spaces, meeting rooms and events.

name: Sqreen
description: Founded in 2015, Sqreen built developer-friendly AppSec, combining in-app monitoring and protection to surface vulnerabilities and stop attacks in real time. The company was acquired by Datadog in 2021; Point Nine was an early backer.

name: StarOfService
description: Founded in 2012 in Paris, StarOfService is an online marketplace that connects consumers with local professionals across hundreds of services – from home improvement to photography – by collecting requests, matching pros, and enabling quotes and bookings.

name: Storefront
description: Storefront, founded in 2014, is an online marketplace that makes offline retail accessible on demand by connecting brands with short-term retail spaces for pop-ups and experiential stores across major global cities. Acquired by PopUp Immo, a company specializing in short-term retail space rentals.

name: StuDocu
description: StuDocu is a global student-to-student learning platform where learners share and discover course-specific study materials, now enhanced by AI tools for quizzes and flashcards. Founded in 2013 in the Netherlands, it serves tens of millions of students worldwide.

name: StyleSeat
description: StyleSeat is a marketplace and business platform for beauty and barber professionals, helping them get discovered by new clients and run operations with online booking, scheduling, payments, and marketing tools. Founded in 2011, it connects millions of clients with independent stylists across the U.S.

name: SuperAnnotate
description: SuperAnnotate is an end-to-end data platform for multimodal AI that unifies dataset creation, curation, labeling, and quality management with model evaluation and fine-tuning. Teams use it to accelerate computer vision and GenAI workflows, deliver better models, and manage data at scale.

name: Superpopcorn
description: Superpopcorn was a Germany-based mobile platform that helped users browse showtimes and reserve or buy cinema tickets quickly and securely.

name: Tenderly
description: Tenderly is a full‑stack Web3 infrastructure and developer platform for EVM chains, combining high‑performance Node RPC and a Web3 Gateway with Virtual TestNets, transaction simulation, debugging, monitoring, and alerting to help teams build, ship, and scale dapps with end‑to‑end observability.

name: Tengo
description: Tengo is an AI-powered platform that helps companies find, qualify, and respond to public tenders at scale. It centralizes opportunities, automates analysis and answer drafting, and streamlines collaboration from discovery to submission for faster, higher-quality bids.

name: Thalamed
description: Thalamed was a B2B marketplace that helped doctors, clinics, and hospitals find, compare, and purchase medical equipment by requesting quotes from leading manufacturers. Acquired in 2021.

name: TheBrief
description: TheBrief (formerly Creatopy) is an AI agency that unifies ad creation, campaign launch, and optimization. It helps teams run ads directly to major channels, generate dynamic creatives at scale, and leverage AI agents for ongoing recommendations and faster, more consistent results.

name: Tier
description: Founded in Berlin in 2018, Tier built a leading shared micromobility platform for e‑scooters and e‑bikes across Europe and beyond, focused on safe, sustainable urban transport. In 2024, Tier merged with Dott to create one of Europe’s largest operators.

name: TradeLink
description: TradeLink is a logistics collaboration platform that digitizes delivery coordination between warehouses, suppliers, and carriers – covering slot booking, dock and yard management, driver check-in, and load carrier tracking – to make inbound flows predictable, cut waiting times, and improve on-time performance.

name: Tripaneer
description: Tripaneer is a leading marketplace for multi-day, themed travel experiences, spanning yoga and meditation retreats, surf camps, safaris, culinary vacations, and more. Founded in 2013 and based in Amsterdam, it helps travelers discover and safely book unforgettable trips worldwide.

name: Typeform
description: Typeform, founded in Barcelona in 2012, helps businesses collect insights and leads through beautifully designed, conversational forms, surveys, and quizzes. Today, Typeform has evolved into an AI-powered engagement platform, where users can build and edit interactive forms instantly using natural language prompts.

name: Unamo
description: Founded in 2012 as Positionly and later rebranded to Unamo, the company provided an integrated platform for SEO ranking, on-page optimization, and social media monitoring to help teams manage and grow their online presence.

name: Unbounce
description: Unbounce, founded in 2009 in Vancouver, was one of the first and leading platforms for building high-converting landing pages without code. Over time it expanded into a conversion intelligence platform, adding several AI tools to further boost performance and ROI.

name: Upciti
description: Paris-based Upciti provides urban intelligence via on‑device computer vision sensors and software that turn real‑time street activity into actionable metrics for traffic, infrastructure, and livability. Used by municipalities worldwide, Upciti processes data locally to protect citizens’ privacy.

name: UpCodes
description: UpCodes is a comprehensive building-code compliance platform for architects, engineers, and contractors. Founded in 2016, it unifies searchable codes across jurisdictions, collaboration tools, and Copilot – an AI assistant that answers project-specific code questions with cited sections.

name: Userfox
description: Userfox built tools to design and send behavior-triggered, personalized emails, enabling startups and SaaS companies to onboard, engage, and retain users. The Y Combinator–backed company was acquired by AdRoll in 2014 to expand its CRM and email capabilities.

name: Vend
description: Founded in Auckland in 2010, Vend built one of the first cloud POS systems for independent retailers, offering inventory, multi-store, loyalty, and real-time reporting. Backed early by Point Nine, Vend was acquired by Lightspeed in 2021, where its technology continues to power modern retail operations.

name: Vercept
description: Founded by world-class AI researchers in Seattle, Vercept is training a foundational model for how computers use computers. Its product, Vy, lets you command your machine with natural language, navigating apps, content, and context seamlessly.

name: Vev
description: Vev provides free, modern software for independent professionals and small teams to run service businesses end-to-end. The platform offers online booking, payments, scheduling, team management, and lightweight CRM.

name: Whereby
description: Whereby provides secure, no-download video meetings and a developer-friendly video API used across telehealth, education, and customer support. Founded in Norway as appear.in in 2013 and rebranded in 2019, the company focuses on simplicity, customization, and privacy-first design.

name: Wikifarmer
description: Wikifarmer is a global platform that empowers farmers with free, expert-led education and a B2B marketplace to sell directly to verified buyers. It promotes fair, transparent agri-food trade and traceability while helping buyers source quality, sustainably produced goods.

name: Workerbase
description: Workerbase helps factories modernize operations with a no-code connected worker suite for digital work instructions, task management, alerts, and data capture – linking people, machines, and IT systems. Manufacturers use it to boost productivity, quality, and agility without rebuilding the shop floor.

name: xChange
description: Container xChange helps logistics companies buy, sell, and lease shipping containers worldwide on a trusted marketplace, with tools for tracking, partner vetting, and secure payments. Headquartered in Hamburg, the company serves thousands of members across global hubs.

name: Xeneta
description: Xeneta is the leading ocean and air freight rate benchmarking and market intelligence platform, using crowdsourced data to deliver real-time pricing, capacity, and index insights that help shippers, forwarders, and carriers benchmark, plan, and negotiate better.

name: Yogaia
description: Yogaia is an online wellness platform offering live and on-demand yoga, Pilates, strength, and mindfulness classes you can join from anywhere. Founded in Finland in 2013, it pioneered live, interactive sessions with optional camera-on feedback to bring studio energy home.

name: Zauber
description: Zauber is building the AI operating system for logistics, unifying tools like spot rate requests and TMS booking to automate planning and execution across the supply chain. Founded by Erik Muttersbach, co-founder of Forto, one of Europe’s largest digital freight forwarders, Zauber applies deep industry expertise to streamline global freight workflows through an integrated, AI-first platform.

name: Zenaton
description: Zenaton was a developer-focused workflow orchestration platform that automated and supervised complex business processes, handling retries and powering event-driven background jobs with simple code across workers and queues.

name: ZenML
description: ZenML is an open-source MLOps and LLMOps framework that helps teams build reproducible, production-ready ML pipelines across any stack. Its code-first, pipeline-centric approach integrates with popular tools, and a managed cloud adds collaboration, governance, and enterprise support.

description: Zentist provides an AI-powered dental revenue cycle management platform focused on dental support organizations (DSOs) and multi-site dental practices in the US.

description: Accordant Health Services, a CVS Caremark company, was the recognized leader in delivering disease management and case management services for patients with rare chronic conditions to members, caregivers, physicians and payers.

description: Adimab is the industry’s premier human antibody discovery and optimization platform defined by speed, diversity, and quality.

description: Adnexus was a leader in the discovery and development of Adnectins, a proprietary type of targeted biologic.

description: Advanced Inhalation Research (AIR) was a private company focused on the development of pharmaceutical products based on proprietary pulmonary drug delivery technologies.

description: Ajax focuses on accelerating innovative medical device technology opportunities that address significant unmet clinical needs.

description: Akili is creating personalized high-end interactive action video games informed by decades of neuroscience and built with proprietary technology developed to target and treat cognitive impairments at their specific sources in the brain.

description: Alector is combining state-of-the-art antibody technology and recent discoveries in neuroimmunology and human genetics to develop novel therapeutics for Alzheimer’s disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.

description: Alimera Sciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company that specializes in the research, development and commercialization of prescription ophthalmic pharmaceuticals.

description: Alnylam is a biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapeutics based on RNA interference, or RNAi.

description: Amplifire is a proprietary adaptive eLearning software and content development platform supported by brain science research.

description: Amunix is a platform company developing technology for tumor-specific activation of T-cell engagers.

name: Ankyra
description: Ankyra is developing a platform to significantly improve both the safety and efficacy of cytokine immunotherapies for cancer.

name: Arsenal Medical

description: ​​OLX makes it easy to connect people to buy, sell or exchange used goods and services. It’s completely free, and it can be used from a laptop or mobile phone. Every month, hundreds of millions of people use OLX to find and sell furniture, musical instruments, cars, houses and more.

name: OLX Brazil
description: In Brazil since 2010, OLX Brasil has the mission of empowering people to achieve their dreams, reinventing the consumption model. The company is 100% digital and does so through technology developed locally, helping its users to buy and sell almost everything quickly, safely and conveniently. By encouraging reuse, OLX Brasil contributes to the reduction of waste, CO2 emissions and encourages the use of natural resources, giving the items a second, third and even fourth life.

name: Onsi
description: Onsi provides an easy way for businesses to reward their workers. The platform helps businesses build programmes that drive loyalty and engagement, delivering a wide range of benefits to workers via their Onsi Card.

name: Orbii

name: Otodom
description: Otodom is the most popular real estate platform in Poland. It enables people to make the most important, life-changing decisions, making the process of selling, buying or renting more convenient and safer. It inspires and helps fulfil the ambitions of real estate agents and developers too.​​​​

name: OTOMOTO
description: Otomoto is the biggest online marketplace for cars and bikes in Poland. It has a massive database of loads of different vehicles, and it connects thousands of dealers and private sellers with millions of potential buyers.

name: Oxford Ionics
description: Oxford Ionics is a high-performance quantum computing company delivering world-leading innovations to create the most powerful, accurate and reliable quantum computers to solve the world's most important problems.

name: PaySense
description: PaySense is a team of engineers, data scientists, product managers, and finance, e-commerce and business development experts. PaySense is available in nine major cities, including Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bangalore and Chennai, with expansion plans to go pan-India soon. PaySense offers flexibility in loan plans and repayment options that run over three, six, and nine months, allowing customers to manage their cash flows better.

name: PayU
description: PayU is a leading financial services provider in global growth markets. The company uses its expertise and heritage in cross-border and local payments to extend services to merchants and consumers. Its innovative technology, developed in-house and through investments and strategic partnerships, empowers billions of people and millions of merchants to buy and sell online, extending the reach of financial services. PayU’s local operations span seventeen growth markets across Asia, Central and Eastern Europe, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa. The company delivers fast, simple and efficient financial services technology unlocks access to more than 2.3 billion consumers in our regions.

name: PharmEasy

name: Platzi

name: QOSMIC

name: Rain

Serving 2.5M+ workers and distributing $2B+ in wages, it boosts hiring, productivity, and retention while offering tools for saving and credit-building.

name: Red Dot Payment
description: Red Dot Payment is a trusted online payment company providing premium payment solutions and expertise to the brightest merchants in Asia Pacific. The company is a trusted fintech partner of banks, merchants, credit card associations, online payment gateways, non-banking financial institutions, and security and fraud management system providers.

name: Remitly
description: Remitly is the largest independent digital remittance company headquartered in the United States, transferring nearly $4 billion in annualised volume from its customers in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada to loved ones worldwide. The company’s proprietary global transfer network includes its easy-to-use mobile app, which makes sending money faster, more accessible, transparent and less costly by eliminating the forms, codes, agents, extra time and fees typical of the traditional, century-old money transfer process. The company is headquartered in Seattle, with additional offices in London, the Philippines, and Nicaragua.

name: Republic

name: Sabi

name: Shipper

name: ShopUp

name: SimilarWeb

With a mission to enhance decision-making in the online world, SimilarwWeb analyses millions of mobile apps and billions of web pages. SimilarwWeb is used daily by publishers, marketers and analysts to benchmark performance and informs company strategy.

name: Skillsoft
description: Skillsoft delivers transformative learning experiences that propel organisations and people to grow together. Through a portfolio of best-in-class content, a platform that is personalised and connected to customer needs, world-class tech and a broad ecosystem of partners, Skillsoft drives continuous growth and performance for employees and their organisations. Skillsoft is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (SKIL.N). Skillsoft acquired Codecademy in April 2022 to further the company’s technology & development segment.

name: SpotDraft

name: Stack Overflow
description: Since 2008, Stack Overflow has been the foundation of the world’s technical community. Today, it serves millions of people monthly as one of the most visited websites globally. Beyond its public platform, the company drives growth through Stack Internal – a private knowledge ecosystem used by thousands of organizations. It helps teams validate expertise and use AI with confidence, ensuring technical knowledge stays accurate and accessible where work actually happens.

name: Standvirtual
description: ​​​Standvirtual is the place to go to buy or sell cars in Portugal. Standvirtual has been around for more than 18 years and is still one of the best ways to buy or sell cars, both privately and with trade dealers.​​​​

Its businesses, products and services have created China's largest internet community, providing social networking, gaming, messaging, payments, communication, and information. With nearly a billion instant messenger active monthly users, Tencent is the parent company of world-renowned brands such as QQ.com, QQ Games, Qzone, Weixin, WeChat, and Tenpay. Founded in November 1998 and headquartered in Shenzhen, we first invested in Tencent in 2001.

name: Tierra Biosciences
description: Tierra Biosciences is a leading global company that provides unique access to cutting-edge engineered proteins. They use advanced technologies to design and create these proteins, using data and artificial intelligence to push the limits of what's possible, surpassing nature.

name: Tonik
description: Tonik is the first digital-only neobank in the Philippines, providing loan, deposit, payment and card products to consumers. It operates out of hubs in Singapore (HQ), Manila, Chennai and Kyiv.

name: Urban Company
description: Urban Company is a leading tech-enabled home services marketplace, with service partners across India, the UAE, Singapore, Australia and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The marketplace offers a variety of home services to consumers, including beauty treatments, haircuts, deep cleaning, plumbing, carpentry and appliance repairs.

name: Vegrow
description: Vegrow is a leading marketplace for the $60bn fruit business in India. It focuses on matchmaking across demand and supply, and value chain innovation, through its deep tech stack.

name: Zapia
description: Zapia is an all-in-one AI assistant built for Latin America that helps users save time, save money, and live better. Accessible via WhatsApp, Zapia provides personalized support for tasks like setting reminders, summarizing content, and discovering products and services—all in a chat-based interface.

name: Zest Equity
description: Zest Equity is a fintech platform focused on democratizing access to private market investments. It leverages advanced technology to streamline investment processes, reduce barriers to entry, and provide transparent, data-driven insights for both individual and institutional investors.

name: Zooz

Today, ZOOZ has become a leading solution which offers companies an unbiased, top-of-the-line payment technology to connect, manage and optimise their payments by their actual performance.

Led by Dr. Nirav Shah , former stroke director of Swedish Neuroscience Institute, Alertive’s approach is unique. The company blends off-the-shelf hardware with proprietary software to create an impressive remote monitoring solution. Alertive leverages its own medical staff to identify and assess potential concerns in patient data (e.g., blood pressure) and suggest actions for the patient in near real-time. We're deeply proud of the life-saving work that Nirav and the team are doing.

name: Archera
description: Archera.ai uses data science to help companies automate and optimize their AWS financial management. They can automatically decrease cloud costs 35% while saving ops & finance teams hours a week on cloud billing administration. The company was founded by Aran Khanna, Nikhil Khanna, and Daniel Christianto, who have deep cloud experience from their backgrounds at Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure.

name: Arrived
description: Arrived is a crowdfunding platform that allows anyone to purchase shares of rental properties and earn a passive income while the company handles everything from property acquisition to necessary improvements and management of daily operations. The startup was founded by tech veterans including CEO Ryan Frazier (Simply Measured and Sprout Social); CTO Kenny Cason , (Simply Measured); and COO Alejandro Chouza , (Oyo and Uber). High-powered backers include the venture capital arms of Jeff Bezos (Bezos Expeditions) and Marc Benioff (Time Ventures); former Zillow Group CEO Spencer Rascoff; Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi, and other longtime tech execs. ‍

name: BigBox VR
description: BigBox VR is on a mission is to combine platform-defining games, social communities, and competitive play to create a VR esport ecosystem. It was founded in by Chia Chin Lee and Gabe Brown, serious game industry veterans who led successful exits and launched top-grossing live service products at Valve, Disney, Sony, and Microsoft.

name: Bluepill
description: BluePill builds "AI consumers" — digital twins of real audiences modeled on behavioral data, interviews, and survey responses — that brands use to test packaging, claims, product concepts, and ad creative in minutes rather than weeks. It sells mainly to consumer-goods insights and brand teams, positioning against traditional panel research from Ipsos, Qualtrics, and Nielsen by benchmarking its simulated responses against parallel live human panels.

name: Boltive
description: Publishers face significant security challenges from malware and unwanted content being delivered through the ads on their sites. Brands need to enforce digital media compliance by ensuring that partners or malicious actors are not misusing their brand. Both publishers and brands are obligated to follow privacy regulations, safeguard user information and respect their rights. CEO Dan Frechtling and team solve this problem.

name: Boundless
description: After helping to develop the next generation of physical retail at Amazon, Xiao Wang wanted to tackle an even bigger problem: the U.S. immigration system. Xiao worked with PSL to assemble a dream team to build, validate, and launch Boundless, which today empowers families to navigate the immigration process more confidently, rapidly, and affordably.

name: Certivo
description: Certivo keeps documentation current, suppliers and manufacturers responsive, and global regulations tracked in the background so launch dates don’t slip and revenue lands on time.

name: Copper
description: Copper Banking was founded with the mission to help teens gain real-world experience with money by giving them access in a way that traditional banks aren’t able to do. The Copper app and debit card teach teens how to make smart financial decisions by creating a platform for parents and teens to connect. ‍

name: Dance Church
description: Dance Church is a joyful, inclusive approach to fitness — through dance. After admiring the incredible brand and movement that Kate Wallich built with Dance Church over the last decade, PSL partnered with her to turn Dance Church into a technology company. We dedicated the same resources we do when we co-found any company: business, engineering, product design, recruiting, etc. to build and launch the Dance on Demand product. We worked closely with Kate to identify and recruit the perfect business partner for her: Clara Siegel, Dance Church’s fantastic new CEO. ‍

name: Dropzone AI
description: Most security teams are only able to fully research about 10% of daily events. Dropzone’s pre-trained AI security agents use large language models and work alongside human security analysts, handling repetitive tasks and investigating alerts. The agents mimic the thought process and techniques of expert security analysts.

name: Empwr
description: Empwr.ai sells an AI program manager for enterprise teams running complex, cross-functional programs, aimed at automotive, consumer packaged goods, software, and industrials. It joins meetings as a notetaker and connects to Jira, Linear, Slack, Confluence, Asana, and calendar tools to build a knowledge graph of decisions, risks, and dependencies, then flags program drift and drafts status updates without anyone entering data by hand.

name: Enzzo
description: Experience unparalleled compression in your hardware programs. From requirements generation to intelligent risk mitigation and seamless collaboration, Enzzo unlocks your team's hardware superpowers.

name: EverGreen
description: Ever.green enables businesses to make a direct impact on climate change by making Renewable Energy Certificates easy to access. Founded by Cris Eugster and Michael Leggett , the company brings greater transparency to the impact of every REC for every renewable energy project on the planet.

name: Felix & Fido
description: Felix&Fido is reimagining the veterinary care experience through a combination of 24/7 telemedicine, in-clinic, and at-home care. The membership model allows us to invest in your pet’s health. Our relationship does not start and end with an office visit. Unlike traditional care which is delivered in 20-minute appointments, we are available to you and your pet on a continuous basis in and out of the clinic. Starting in the Greater Issaquah area with our state-of-the-art clinic, we’re excited to provide the best care for pets and the best work environment for our dedicated veterinary care team.

name: Frontier Instruments
description: Frontier Instruments is a Seattle applied-AI company building Eureka, an intelligent system of record for research and development in regulated industries — biopharma, CROs and CDMOs, and medical devices. It aims to carry context across the whole R&D loop, from hypothesis and test design through readout analysis to the next iteration, tying each step to the underlying evidence and regulations so the resulting work is defensible in a regulatory submission.

name: Genba
description: The manufacturing floor is one of the world’s most essential value-creators. But the job of managing the complex workflows and knowledge required to keep plants up and running is painfully slow and inefficient — frontline industrial teams are just “getting by” with software not designed for them. Through our joint innovation studio with Fortive, PSL dug into the problem with co-founders Bruce Kaufman and Emory Sullivan in the fall of 2020. After hundreds of hours of customer discovery, countless design iterations, and a powerful voice recognition application (trained for the industrial environment), we brought to market an elegant solution. Workers and plant managers thought so too. GE Power and several others have already adopted Genba. Our voice-driven work order solution allows technicians to accurately speak their way through jobs and eliminate traditional paperwork. Plants will run more efficiently and voice-enabled workers will never have to touch a computer again.

name: Glow
description: Podcasting is exploding, and everyone knows it. But there’s just one problem: podcasters are dramatically under-monetizing the incredible amount of time spent listening. Amira Valliani is on a mission to enable podcasters to build businesses with Glow. Amira brought her extensive background in the podcast ecosystem to partner with PSL, who was experimenting with direct monetization in podcasting on the Acquired podcast. PSL worked with Amira to build the initial product, onboard early customers, and bring on her co-founder Brian Elieson , who has shipped some of the world’s most popular voice and media products at Microsoft and Amazon.

name: Glue
description: In partnership with PSL's corporate innovation studio, Fortive , PSL and founder David Sulpy spent months testing and validating Glue . Could AI and technology radically accelerate the development, optimization, and testing of complex hardware systems? The customers we spoke to unanimously highlighted this pain point, and PSL engineers demonstrated massive efficiencies through their proof of concept. Who better to lead this company than David, who most recently spearheaded this effort at Tektronix as the VP/GM of Test Automation and Software Solutions? We launched the company with a working product and early design partners. Glue Studio has raised seed funding, led by Fortive, and has already proven to be highly 'sticky' with its early customers.

name: Gradient
description: Bobby Figueroa is one of the world’s leading experts about how massive brands can effectively advertise and sell online. Having led global operations for Amazon’s fast-growing advertising platform, where over 50% of online product searches now start, he was perfectly-positioned to start the next great platform company for brands to reach their customers. When Bobby met with PSL about partnering on his idea to build a new generation of Intelligent Insights platform for ecommerce, powered by ML, it had a great match with an internal project for a digital marketing company. He quickly dove in with the PSL team to develop product direction, bring on early customers, and raise a seed round from PSL's investor network. He is joined by CTO Norman Shi, who spent time at Google and Yahoo! working with Bobby in building large scale digital advertising platforms. Norman has extensive experience Big Data and ML systems. They most recently were joined by Jay Sampson, CRO for gradient.io , who is bringing decades of experience in partnerships with many of the largest global brands and agencies for digital advertising and marketing clouds platforms.

name: Gumshoe
description: Gumshoe.ai is an “SEO for AI” platform that audits how large‑language‑model search tools—such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity—mention your brand, benchmarks those mentions against competitors, and delivers tactical recommendations to boost your visibility in AI‑generated answers.

name: HouseWhisper
description: HouseWhisper is an AI teammate for real estate that handles lead management tasks and remembers every detail so agents don’t have to. It aims to be every real estate agent’s personal assistant, taking on the busy work so agents can focus on what matters—closing deals.‍

name: Iteratively
description: Iteratively helps data teams, product managers and engineers define, instrument, verify and collaborate on analytics tracking. We proactively empower teams to identify and resolve data quality issues and provide a workflow for managing the evolution of your analytics tracking, ensuring data consumers always have high-quality and ready to use data in their favorite tools. Iteratively was founded in 2019 by Patrick Thompson and Ondrej Hrebicek and is a remote-first company.

name: Joon
description: The United States is facing a heartbreaking mental health crisis, particularly among teenagers and young adults. After learning about the overwhelming need for mental health care for youth while volunteering with Seattle area nonprofits, PSL Entrepreneur in Residence Josh Herst turned his attention to this important issue. And shortly after PSL introduced Josh to Joon co-founder and Chief Psychologist, Dr. Amy Mezulis, the company was serving their first clients. Josh's business, product and operating experience combined with Amy's almost two decades of clinical and research experience focused on adolescent mental health make Joon's founding team uniquely well positioned to take on this mission. Joon is the world’s first teletherapy platform designed exclusively for teens and young adults ages 13-24. Joon delivers a new model for mental health care that integrates the benefits of live one-on-one therapy sessions with a mobile app-based experience. Joon’s clinical team uses an evidence-based, skills-focused approach that is personalized for each individual client. ‍

name: Kamiwaza
description: Kamiwaza is lending a helping hand with its software platform that enables generative AI capabilities and doesn’t require a massive workflow overhaul or moving large amounts of data. ‍

name: Kevala
description: Healthcare is the largest and fastest-growing employment sector in the US – but finding and managing healthcare providers is incredibly complex and heavily regulated. Organizations of all sizes are coping with inadequate, outdated tools. Founder Todd Owens believes that modern technology can make onboarding, managing, and engaging care teams dramatically more effective – enter Kevala. The platform targets today’s pain points by allowing facilities to quickly build, organize, and schedule a fully credentialed, on-demand workforce with just a few clicks. ‍

name: Lev
description: Lev is an AI co-founder for early-stage entrepreneurs, built by encoding Pioneer Square Labs' company-building process into software. It runs on an infinite canvas and walks a founder from ideation through validation to formation, generating go-to-market plans, competitive analyses, prospect lists, outreach templates, landing pages, and product specs along the way. ‍

name: LoansIntel
description: LoansIntel was founded in 2020 by Asif Khaja and Max Peara to enhance research and data efficiency in the credit markets. LoansIntel offers high-quality, plug-and-play data and content to support a wide range of functions in the portfolio management process. ‍

name: Lumatax
description: Robert Schulte may just be the world's greatest expert on the pain of state sales tax. He is a former California State Auditor, and he sold his sales tax company, Taxcient, to Avalara. Robert came to PSL to solve the enormous problem of small business sales tax compliance. Working with PSL's developers, designers, and marketers to build version one of the product, Robert raised a significant venture round in just 3 months.

name: MaximalLearning
description: Two decades after selling their startup to Microsoft, Eran Megiddo and Liviu Asnash are returning to their entrepreneurial roots. The longtime Microsoft leaders are the co-founders of Maximal Learning, a new Seattle startup that is using the latest advances in generative AI technology to give students personalized instruction that can cater to different learning styles.

name: Meeting Flow
description: Meetingflow combines 6 tools into one easy meeting workflow to help teams better prepare, eliminate busy work, save time and win with customers. The company connects calendars, notes, CRM and more in an easy workflow to save everyone time and avoid tool fatigue. ‍ ‍ ‍

name: Mudstack
description: Mudstack makes asset management and version control software for game studios and other digital art teams. Its platform combines file-based versioning, digital asset management, and review-and-feedback tools in one place, with an API, webhooks, and AI-assisted search and tagging so studios can automate pipeline work instead of stitching together tools built for engineers. ‍

name: Official AI
description: Official AI is igniting the next creative renaissance by empowering talent to control, protect, and monetize their identity within generative AI. Through a deep tech marketplace, creators can seamlessly search, license, and authenticate pre-cleared publicity rights for use within their preferred generative AI platform. PSL partnered with Mūdita Ventures and founders from Google Widevine to identify and recruit the ideal founding team, composed of Dave Siegfried as CEO and John Pletka as CTO. Together, they bring the expertise in intellectual property, licensing, and security required to successfully build this pioneering marketplace for the creative industries. ‍

name: Olis
description: Olis Connect is a plug-and-play product for remote error recovery of industrial robots. Access directly in browser. Compatible with all UR cobots. ‍

name: Outgo
description: Whether you manage one truck or 100, Outgo simplifies how you manage your business with one simple service for all your financial needs—from invoice and factoring, to banking and expenses. ‍

name: Overland
description: Overland AI is a manufacturer and developer of autonomous navigation for off-road autonomous vehicles.

name: Prom
description: Prom builds software for communities. Every group gets a house: its own rooms, games, and social spaces, designed for how communities actually live together online. The more people show up, the more Prom knows them, powering profiles earned through behavior rather than written by hand.

name: Read
description: Read is changing virtual meetings forever, giving each of us superpowers to interpret what is actually happening in that Zoom room. ‍

name: Recurrent
description: Buying a used car has been essentially the same for 75 years: what’s the mileage, what’s the vehicle history, get a mechanic to check out the moving parts and haggle over the price. As electric cars hit the used market in real numbers for the first time, Scott Case recognized the opportunity to modernize the buying process to reflect fundamental differences in consumer buying behaviors for electric vehicles. Scott partnered with PSL to validate the idea, build the initial product to show customers their estimated battery life, and hone the business model. Scott worked with PSL to recruit co-founding CTO Kyle Rippey , who has never met a marketplace business he wasn't keen to disrupt (dog walking, legal services, real estate, and now automobiles).

name: Remarkably
description: Remarkably is a multifamily marketing data, analytics, and insights platform. Before Remarkably, the largest asset class in the world was being managed by sticky notes, spreadsheets, and emails. Co-founders Anna-Lea Dieringer and Erina Malarkey are industry veterans, and partnered with PSL to transform their deep domain expertise into a product and build a team to solve this problem at scale. With Remarkably, the nation’s top property owners, developers, and managers can drive market-beating performance and revenue.

name: Secure
description: Devin Miller and Bassam Saliba have spent their years as fintech leaders before the term was even coined. They have partnered together on multiple venture-backed startups including Balance Financial (acquired by TaxACT), Finsphere (acquired by VISA) and Avado (acquired by WebMD). In 2020, Devin and Bassam turned their sights on a new fintech concept, the emergency savings account (ESA), and partnered with PSL to validate the concept, identify and land early customers, design the product, and take it from an idea to a real company. The result is Secure, a platform that enables employers to offer ESAs to their employees as a benefit. The sad reality is that 40% of U.S. workers cannot afford an unplanned $400 expense, and financial-related stress costs employers billions of dollars each year. Secure solves these problems by making it easy to offer ESAs to employees, amidst a time where access to emergency savings has never been more important. ‍

name: Shipium
description: Geekwire Yahoo Finance The Information ‍

name: SingleFile
description: Every company needs to follow state and local rules. But staying compliant is messy and time-consuming. At PSL, we incorporate several businesses a year, so we know the issues firsthand, and wanted to build a better way. And who better to attack this problem than a former corporate attorney? Enter Sean Flynn, co-founder and CEO of SingleFile. In short order, Sean and his co-founder Matt Woodward partnered with PSL to validate and build SingleFile’s platform for early customers. SingleFile works with law firms to fill out reports, manage filings and maintain up-to-date information so that companies remain in good standing.

name: Sofy
description: ‍ Syed Hamid is the CEO and founder of Sofy , a no-code automated mobile app testing platform. Millions of people use millions of mobile apps every day, and every app development team must test their app before each and every release and update. This increasingly complex and resource-intensive process is difficult and time-consuming. Fortunately, Sofy’s innovative platform makes the necessity of testing mobile apps swift and painless. Before starting Sofy in 2016, Syed worked as an engineering leader for nearly two decades at Microsoft.

name: Starfish
description: Starfish Space is giving life to on-orbit services. Founded by former Blue Origin and NASA engineers, Starfish is developing the Otter, the first small and versatile space tug that will lower costs and increase availability for satellite servicing missions including life extension and active debris removal. Starfish technologies, including its proprietary CEPHALOPOD software, are key logistics, autonomy, and robotics infrastructure for the developing off-world economy and orbital industries like manufacturing, assembly, tourism, and mining.

name: Super.ai
description: Super.ai is using its revolutionary AI technology to help enterprise companies unlock the monetary value of their unstructured data. Founded by Brad Cordova and Henry Setiawan , two machine learning researchers and engineers from MIT, Google Brain, Microsoft Research, and TrueMotion, the company is based in both Seattle and Berlin.

name: Tally
description: Russell Wilson called PSL with a vision: a platform that enables elite athletes, artists, and celebrities to connect more meaningfully with their fans. Using PSL as a launch pad, he and CEO Jason Leekeenan of Hulu and Zulily fame, built upon the foundation of TraceMe and launched Tally, an events predication app that makes live events more fun for fans of all stripes. #gohawks

name: TeamSense
description: Staying connected with your team has never been more critical. As the first spinout from the PSL/Fortive joint innovation studio, TeamSense helps hourly and shift workers communicate with their employers. Accelerated by COVID-19 symptom tracking needs, Sheila Stafford and PSL quickly rolled out a text-based solution that monitors workers’ health. Since its launch, TeamSense’s suite of text-based tools has expanded to address other needs like employee communication , attendance management , and employee self-service portals .

name: The Instrument
description: The Instrument is building a personalized insurance offering for individuals and families, combining human guidance and service with AI support. For individuals and families who want more from their insurance, the company brings together personal guidance and exceptional, unparalleled service.

name: Tin Can
description: CEO Chet Kittleson, alongside co-founders Molly Braeunig and Max Blumen, played key roles in building and scaling Redfin. As parents, they also bring a unique perspective on the needs of children (and parents) and the challenges they face in the digital age. ‍

name: TrovaTrip
description: TrovaTrip offers trips around the globe hosted by topic experts (think: creators and influencers). They enable these hosts to select off-the-shelf trip itineraries to dozens of geographies around the world, customize them, and then offer the custom trip to their fans/followers. It's a great way for topic experts like yogis, photographers, bloggers, outdoor enthusiasts, and more to monetize their following and passion area, and deepen engagement with their fans.

name: Yesler
description: After two decades in the lumber industry, Matt Meyers knew there had to be a better way than phone calls and post-it notes. Matt came to PSL with a vision of how technology could come to the forest products industry to help everyone — lumber mills, service providers, and lumberyards — do business better. Together with PSL's engineering, design, and customer development teams, Matt iterated on concepts and launched Yesler, a B2B marketplace built by the lumber and building materials industry, for the industry. Matt worked with PSL to recruit CTO Jeff Lubetkin , who brings his decades of marketplace technology experience from Expedia and Zillow. Matt and Jeff are also joined by David Helmers , who previously led Weyerhaeuser's $1.5 billion building materials distribution business. ‍

name: Aurora Solar
description: In 2012, while still in graduate school, Sam and Chris installed a commercial solar system for a school in East Africa. The project was a resounding success, allowing the school to save on its electricity bills as well as have a reliable and carbon-free source of energy. However, Sam and Chris experienced firsthand the inefficiency of the solar sales, design, and commissioning process. Although the system itself took only a few weeks to install, research, financial calculations, and system design took several months. Talking to other solar installers, they found that soft-costs were impeding the growth of the industry. Based on these experiences, they founded Aurora with the goal of enabling any solar professional to design and sell an optimal solar project in minutes. To date, Aurora has been used to design over 1,000,000 solar installations. And we're just getting started!
