description: Boba Bhai is building a QSR brand centred around bubble teas, Korean burgers and more. It is transforming bubble tea into an affordable QSR product with unique Indian flavours.

name: Boxs
description: Boxs is a design-to-build automation platform for architects and designers.

name: Bruno Milano
description: Bruno Milano is a modern watch brand creating design-led, hand-finished quartz and chronograph watches at accessible price points. Backed by over 20 years of watch design and manufacturing experience, the brand combines timeless design, honest craftsmanship and fair pricing for the modern Indian buyer.

name: Cart.com
description: Cart.com is the first end-to-end eCommerce solutions provider delivering a fully integrated and owned suite of software, services and infrastructure to scale businesses online. Founded by ecommerce veterans to be the premiere Ecommerce-as-a-Service (ECaaS) provider, Cart.com is on a mission to put brands back in charge of their ecommerce journey and their customer relationships. Today, Cart.com offers a wealth of business solutions including online store software; digital marketing, fulfilment, and financial services; customer service capabilities; and unified analytics across all areas of commerce and marketing performance so brands of any size can work with a single partner to access the same capabilities as the world’s largest ecommerce companies.

name: Chefkart
description: ChefKart is an end-to-end kitchen aide that plans, shops and cooks for you in your home kitchen. Aimed at busy professionals who want home-cooked food without the time or skill, it provides trained, verified home cooks plus pantry management and meal planning.

name: Cherry
description: Cherry is a shopping app for creators where anyone with 1000+ followers and a public Instagram profile can shop from 350+ brands and earn cashback each time they post about their purchase. The platform has 30,000 creators and 350+ brands.

name: Circle
description: Circle is a full-stack C2C marketplace built on the belief that buying and selling pre-owned goods should feel safe, easy and trustworthy. It brings AI-led verification, guided pricing, catalogue matching, secure payments and managed doorstep logistics to every transaction, aiming to enable 100 million Indians to participate in circular commerce.

name: CityMall
description: CityMall is a social e-commerce venture aiming to help the next 400 million new-to-internet users realise the power of e-commerce. It builds India's largest chain of WhatsApp-based virtual stores run by neighbourhood community leaders, empowering thousands of micro-entrepreneurs to bring online commerce to Bharat.

name: Claimbuddy
description: ClaimBuddy is a MediClaim support company acting as a one-stop solution for claim assistance for patients and hospitals. It facilitates an ecosystem for hassle-free insurance claims by leveraging technology and a set of simple yet powerful processes and operations.

name: Clarity
description: Clarity is building a marketplace of paid listeners providing 24x7 support to people going through emotional distress who want to share their problems anonymously, without fear of being judged.

name: Clickpost
description: Clickpost is one of Asia's fastest-growing integrated logistics platforms for e-commerce companies. Processing tens of millions of shipments per month, it helps customers implement cutting-edge logistics intelligence.

name: Cloudfiles
description: Cloudfiles is a cloud-based platform for file sharing. It lets users supercharge their files with enterprise-grade security, page-by-page analytics and powerful content automations.

name: Contravault
description: Founded in 2024, ContraVault was created with a clear mission: to empower businesses in developing economies like India by transforming the tendering and contracting landscape. It helps companies navigate complex tenders and RFPs by reducing inefficiencies in project execution, surfacing bid risks, and improving tender analysis.

name: Convin
description: Convin uses conversation intelligence to help sales teams close more deals - replicating top reps' behaviours, fast-tracking onboarding with real call examples, ensuring processes are followed, and surfacing market intelligence from calls to guide product and marketing teams.

name: Credgenics
description: Credgenics is a first-of-its-kind NPA resolution platform working with banks, NBFCs and digital lending firms to improve collections efficiency using technology, automation intelligence and optimal legal routes. Its SaaS-based collections platform helps major lenders improve their NPAs, geographic reach and customer experience.

name: CuePilot
description: CuePilot is a voice-first, AI-native platform built for preschools and daycares. It automates up to 80% of administrative work by converting everyday classroom interactions into structured insights, keeping teachers focused on children while enabling school leaders to operate with clarity at scale.

name: Dealshare
description: DealShare is a fast-growing social e-commerce platform for multi-category consumer products, focused on the new 'WhatsApp-first' India. It makes online buying easy in a couple of clicks for users new to e-commerce, and lets them buy and share deals with friends.

name: DotPe
description: DotPe is an online-to-offline commerce platform spanning merchants from rural India to large F&B players. Its Digital Showroom app lets small and medium businesses open a digital storefront in under 15 seconds, with a complete suite of solutions to manage the entire customer journey.

name: Drinkprime
description: DrinkPrime is on a mission to provide access to clean, safe and healthy drinking water. Started to solve a personal problem - reliable access to clean water - it offers RO filters and purifiers on a subscription model.

name: Echovane
description: Echovane is a research execution and insight-delivery service for consumer insights, market research, product, UX and marketing teams. We combine multimodal AI with global ethnographic scale to deliver the precise, trusted clarity required to drive your business forward. Our AI agents can design and coordinate multi-stage studies; find, screen and verify highly specific participants globally; conduct interviews, observations and surveys using voice, video, text and other research stimuli; and analyse qualitative and quantitative information together. We then convert the research into decision-ready outputs such as presentations, reports, dashboards, structured datasets, participant quotations, video clips and insight reels.

name: Elevate Now
description: Elevate Now is India's first doctor-led medical weight loss programme. It treats the root cause - metabolism, not willpower - using clinically proven medications (including GLP-1s), targeted supplementation and personalised protocols, with behavioural coaching running alongside from day one.

name: Eluno
description: Eluno is building India's premium eyewear destination - a design-first, fashion-forward alternative to Western luxury brands, reimagined for the modern Indian consumer. It crafts high-quality, ethically made eyewear that blends modern aesthetic design with individually customised comfort and vision clarity.

name: Fae Beauty
description: FAE (Free And Equal) Beauty is a beauty and skincare brand that conceptualises and creates inclusive products for every Indian skin tone. It is committed to innovative, effective, accessible products for every skin tone, texture and undertone, championing authentic, unfiltered representation.

name: Fashinza
description: Fashinza is a new-age supply chain and product development platform for the fashion industry. Founded by serial entrepreneurs and IIT Delhi graduates, it offers manufacturing-as-a-service through a powerful technology platform that helps customers scale efficiently.

name: Ferra(Aroleap)
description: Ferra is a guided home strength training system designed to help people age gracefully. Through a subscription-based model, Ferra installs a smart strength machine at home and pairs it with a habit-first programme focused on building and maintaining functional strength, reducing visceral fat, and improving cardiovascular fitness — sustainably and safely. Ferra is not about short-term transformations. It is about long-term independence — helping people stay strong, capable, and self-reliant into their 80s and 90s

name: Fix Health (YourPhysio)
description: FixHealth aims to provide relief to people with back and joint pain. With sedentary jobs and chronic conditions making back and joint pain a modern epidemic, FixHealth delivers good-quality physiotherapy care at the click of a button.

name: Fleek
description: Fleek aims to simplify the world of subscriptions by giving users control over their recurring spend. As more spend categories move to digital subscriptions, Fleek helps users manage and share them.

name: Fleetx
description: Fleetx is an AI-driven freight movement platform that helps supply chain and logistics stakeholders digitise their operations and make smart decisions based on real-time, actionable insights.

name: FlickTV
description: Flick TV is building a mobile-first OTT suitable for snackable consumption. Imagined as a hybrid of a television soap opera and an Instagram reel, it is designed for phone screens and shorter attention spans - a quick fix for anyone with as little as a minute to spare.

name: For Real
description: For Real is India's go-to outlet destination, enabling brands to sell unsold and previous-season inventory directly to consumers at the best value. The platform creates a trusted bridge between brands and shoppers, ensuring authenticity, smart pricing and a seamless outlet experience.

name: Fyllo
description: Based on real-time farm data and insights, Fyllo helps farmers make precise decisions and increase productivity. Its algorithms understand soil conditions and stage-wise crop water requirements to provide an optimum irrigation schedule and achieve the desired quality of produce.

name: Fynd
description: Fynd is India's largest omnichannel platform helping retail businesses accelerate growth. A one-stop solution trusted by over 600 brands and 10,000 stores, it reduces the complexity of adding new brands, channels, store locations and fulfilment centres, with features spanning catalogue, centralised inventory, multiple sales channels, order management, marketing and payments.

name: Geniebook
description: Geniebook is a Singapore-based EdTech company and Singapore's largest online learning platform for the English, Mathematics and Science (EMS) syllabus. Its suite of products spans AI-personalised worksheets, live classes and chats designed to help primary and secondary students improve rapidly.

name: Gimi Michi
description: Gimi Michi is reimagining instant food for the modern Indian consumer. Tired of the limited and often artificial options in the market, they set out to craft the real deal—starting with Korean Kimchi Ramen that’s made in India, but rooted in traditional Korean flavour. Every bowl of Gimi Michi is backed by months of R&D, real tasting panels, and obsessive attention to detail—from the chewy, long-strand noodles to our signature seasoning and vegetable blend. It’s not just a snack—it’s a full meal experience.

name: GIVA
description: GIVA is an online-first silver jewellery store with a vision to provide authentic, elegant and affordable jewellery. Started in 2019, GIVA has grown rapidly to become one of India’s leading silver jewellery brands.

name: GoKwik
description: GoKwik is an e-commerce enablement platform that helps brands improve conversions and reduce return-to-origin (RTO). It tackles the difficulties shoppers face in the buying experience on e-commerce websites to drive better outcomes for businesses.

name: Handpickd
description: Handpickd is India's first zero-stock, match-making platform for fresh produce, serving households in Gurgaon, Noida and Bangalore. It delivers pesticide-free, plastic-free produce sourced directly from farmers, with each order personalised to household needs (ripeness, weight, weekly quantity) - using a zero-inventory, zero-warehousing model to remove wastage from the supply chain.

name: Hatica
description: Hatica is an analytics platform that enables engineering leaders to improve team productivity, effectiveness and well-being. It connects with workplace tools to provide actionable insights into team activity, effort and outcomes, helping leaders drive delivery and engagement without burnout.

name: Headout
description: Headout is an on-demand mobile marketplace that helps travellers discover and book tours, activities, events and local experiences at exclusive prices in just a few taps. It works with small and medium experience providers to standardise a highly fragmented industry, connecting high-quality experiences with people worldwide.

name: Heizen
description: Heizen helps you ship production-grade products in days—not months by combining AI agents with top 1% engineers. It works as an on-demand tech team, delivering internal tools and product features in weekly sprints.

name: HireForCare
description: HireForCare is a tech-enabled platform connecting families with trained caregivers and therapists for children with special needs. Its Special Child Centre delivers trusted, professional Speech and Occupational Therapy for autistic and ADHD children, on the family's schedule and at home.

name: Homerun
description: HomeRun is redefining how construction and interior projects source materials by combining affordability with speed. From cement, steel and tiles to paints and fittings, it delivers low-cost, high-quality supplies to site in 60 minutes, helping contractors, builders and homeowners stay on budget and on time.

name: Hubble
description: Hubble Money offers an app that lets users set lifestyle-related goals, choose flexible savings plans and earn rewards. Features include data sharing, flexible withdrawals and collaboration with friends and family.

name: Hunar.ai
description: Hunar is building tech-driven solutions for the next-generation blue-collar ecosystem. As modern blue-collar jobs demand specialised skills, Hunar uses technologies like AI to modernise recruitment, training and management so growth-driven companies can thrive.

name: Imumz
description: iMumz is a fast-growing platform for Indian pregnant women, with 200,000+ members and trusted by 1,000+ leading doctors. It provides actionable activities like meditation, music, yoga and baby-bonding exercises to help expecting mothers stay physically and mentally healthy and connect with their baby.

name: IndiaGold
description: Trusted by over 10 lakh customers, indiagold provides instant gold loans and secure gold locker services across multiple Indian cities. It is building the technology rails to enable efficient monetisation of India's large private gold reserves.

name: Indian Snack House
description: Indian Snack House is on a mission to bring the authentic taste of South Indian snacks to the world. A 100% clean-label brand - free from palm oil, preservatives and artificial additives - it crafts regional favourites with purity and tradition, making native South Indian snacks accessible across India and beyond.

name: IndusOS
description: Indus OS is a homebred system-apps company building India's content and commerce platform for users to discover and consume digital content and services in their language of choice. Made in India, it is built on innovation, simplification and localisation to address low digital awareness, linguistic challenges and the lack of local content.

name: InPrime
description: InPrime recognises an underserved sub-segment within the informal economy, combining the winning attributes of traditional lending with modern, data- and technology-driven practices. It aims to generate superior financial and non-financial outcomes without compromising customer connect, engagement and risk management.

name: Inspektlabs
description: Inspektlabs is a computer vision technology platform focused on automating inspections of any physical asset using photos and videos. Its products detect damage on camera, eliminating the need for physical inspections.

name: Instafix
description: Instafix is India's fastest doorstep consumer electronics repair service, aiming to change how people service their electronics. Its in-house specialists arrive on site and complete repairs in under 60 minutes, with a warranty.

name: Instasell
description: InstaSell is on a mission to empower 100 million small businesses on Instagram worldwide in their journey to becoming successful solopreneurs.

name: InterviewVector
description: InterviewVector helps companies build talent pipelines without compromising on business growth time. Its interview-as-a-service platform delivers faster, more accurate hiring at lower cost and in less time.

name: Intervue
description: Intervue offers one of the world's fastest collaborative environments for conducting tech interviews. Features include 33+ programming languages, audio/video calling, a question bank, auto-recording and playback, structured interview feedback and collaborative take-home assignments.

name: InVideo
description: InVideo's mission is to reinvent video creation and make it accessible to everyone. Built on the belief that the future of video creation is browser-based, collaborative and easy across devices, its flexible timeline and drag-and-drop editor let users make professional videos within minutes in the browser.

name: IPF
description: IPF (India Parenting Forum) is a peer-to-peer marketplace for parents to buy and sell pre-loved kids' products - from maternity and nursery essentials to strollers, cribs, clothes, toys and gear. With verified users, integrated logistics and secure payments through IPF Pay, it makes parenting more sustainable, affordable and community-driven.

name: Ivy
description: Ivy Homes uses a proprietary algorithm with 30+ parameters to estimate property prices and offer instant liquidity to homeowners, aiming to make selling a home simple, transparent and convenient.

name: Jupiter
description: Jupiter is a digital banking app that aims to deliver a banking experience that keeps pace with users. It helps users cut through banking jargon, offers smart insights based on spending, and provides new-age features to make sense of finances.

name: Karban
description: KARBAN builds energy-efficient, design-oriented airflow appliances, including its flagship Karban Airzone - an integrated bladeless ceiling fan, light and air purifier (3-in-1). Its products help consumers cut electricity bills and carbon footprint while making spaces aesthetically beautiful.

name: Khatabook
description: Khatabook enables micro, small and medium merchants to track business transactions safely and securely. It also offers UPI/QR payment collection, reminders to creditors and report generation.

name: Khyaal
description: Khyaal wants to make the lives of the elderly more comfortable by assisting them with everyday chores - from paying bills to buying groceries and more - in an easy and safe manner.

name: Kindlife
description: Kindlife offers a marketplace of 150+ 'kind' brands across clean beauty, nutrition and home care, all approved by its kindcode - plant-based, organic, toxin-free, eco-conscious or cruelty-free.

name: Knot
description: KNOT delivers fashion in 60 mins but that’s barely scratching the surface - we’re building the new-age fashion destination with Tinder-style discovery, best-in-class virtual try ons and a lot more

name: Koparo
description: Koparo was started by a New Delhi mum with the goal of making effective, plant-powered cleaning and hygiene products that are safe to use in all homes, serving the needs of modern Indian families.

name: Krvvy
description: Krvvy (pronounced Curvy) is a function-first women's innerwear and shapewear brand offering high-quality, innovative products for diverse body types with a focus on comfort, inclusivity and sensitivity. Its portfolio of bras, underwear and shapewear is tailored for Indian women with a solution-first approach.

name: Kutumb
description: Kutumb is India's largest community platform - an app-based social platform ideal for connecting with communities that share similar interests.

name: Laani
description: Laani reimagines body care for women who lead fast-paced lives, through innovative formats and form factors that are as effective as they are effortless. Built for Indian climate and Indian bodies, Laani brings speed, ease and joy to often-skipped routines.

name: Labelbox
description: Labelbox is a platform to train and operate machine intelligence, solving the problem of taking AI and ML initiatives from R&D into production. Its core product makes it easy to create and manage labelled data, enabling rapid deployment of AI applications.

name: Lane
description: Lane is building a full-stack mobility platform that starts with high-quality driving education and expands into car ownership services including vehicle discovery, financing, insurance, and driver intelligence. By combining structured training, trusted marketplaces, and mobility data, Lane is creating a safer and more confident generation of drivers in India.

name: Languify
description: Languify is an AI assistant that analyses, corrects and tracks spoken and written English across platforms. It offers real-time feedback and positive nudges, plus personalised learning plans and games to help users improve their communication.

name: Legistify
description: Legistify is a tech-enabled legal concierge platform serving mid-market and large enterprises with an enterprise legal management (ELM) suite, plus on-demand access to over 7,000 pre-verified lawyers across India.

name: Limechat
description: LimeChat brings conversational AI to e-commerce, enabling brands to deliver delightful customer experiences through messaging at scale. Its Level 3 AI technology, with an exclusive focus on e-commerce, goes beyond stereotypical chatbots to drive sales and customer-support automation for 30+ leading brands.

name: Lingopanda (PingoLearn)
description: Lingopanda (previously PingoLearn) is an English learning app that helps you practise pronunciation and vocabulary, so you can speak English confidently and clearly. Say goodbye to boring grammar drills and rules. Take your English to the next level with our engaging videos and AI-powered speech feedback.

name: Linkrunner
description: Linkrunner is an AI-driven Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) built to help businesses accelerate app growth. It centralises marketing data across performance marketing, influencer, organic, offline and inorganic sources onto one platform, enabling comprehensive tracking of clicks, downloads, revenue, retention, ROAS and CTR.

name: Lio (Registerbook)
description: Lio is a single app to create, keep and track all your records, with a vision to empower people to run their businesses smartly from their mobile phones via simple, intuitive solutions. Available in 10+ languages with 60+ templates and over a million users, it helps users organise data and make meaningful decisions.

name: Localwell
description: Localwell provides B2B SaaS for pharmaceutical retailers to run daily operations such as procurement, billing, inventory, expiry management and payments. It plans to enable factory-to-pharmacy distribution and digital marketing for pharmaceutical manufacturers (outside India's top 10) that have limited distribution and marketing reach.

name: Logipe
description: LogiPe is building a full-stack fintech platform for commercial fleet owners. It provides prepaid cards to owners and drivers to manage trip expenses, and is building trip-financing products (driver credit and BNPL for fleet owners) based on transaction history.

name: Loopworm
description: Loopworm is an agri-biotechnology company that converts organic waste into valuable products promoting health and nourishment for all forms of life. Using novel bioscience, chemistry and technology, it utilises insects to produce bio-based products.

name: Luzo
description: LUZO is India's leading marketplace for salons, spas, and dermatology clinics. Customers discover curated, trusted partners on the app and pay through LUZO and save up to 40%, while partners fill idle capacity with real demand. LUZO operates across the country with more than 3,000 partners and 7 lakh customer downloads.

name: Magma
description: Magma is a B2B manufacturing platform and global supply-first aggregator that helps factories achieve better output, practices and access to global demand.

name: Mamaearth
description: Mamaearth’s mission is to bring the best of nature through pure and nurturing personal care products made without toxins or harmful chemicals.

name: Maya
description: Working towards 'a robot for every human', the team is building Maya, a general-purpose robotic assistant - a first step towards democratising general-purpose machine intelligence that can think, learn and program itself to complete a variety of tasks.

name: Mekr
description: Mekr is building a digital manufacturing platform for the electronics industry, giving product companies access to a vast network of manufacturing partners and suppliers for steady business and working-capital access.

name: Mitigata
description: Mitigata is India's first Smart Cyber Insurance, designed to seamlessly integrate cyber insurance with robust security measures to safeguard organisations from cyber-attacks and financial losses.

name: Moengage
description: MoEngage is an intelligent customer engagement platform for customer-obsessed marketers. It helps businesses analyse customer behaviour and engage with personalised communication across web, mobile and email through analytics, AI-powered journey orchestration and personalisation.

name: Moonshine
description: Moonshine Meadery is Asia and India's first craft meadery, making meads - an alcoholic drink fermented from honey that sits between a beer and a wine. Conceptualised in 2016, it set out to introduce an easy-drinking beverage using the finest ingredients and the latest brewing technology.

name: Mosaic Wellness
description: Mosaic Wellness is a platform of digital-first health clinics operated under one house, each working towards helping Indians lead more fulfilling lives surrounded by wellness and grace. It builds a family of purposeful health platforms offering personalised solutions for specific problems in niche segments.

name: Multiplier
description: Multiplier is a global employment platform that makes it easy for companies to employ teams internationally. Its proprietary technology manages the complexities of local compliance, labour contracts, payroll, benefits and taxes, letting companies run distributed teams from a simple dashboard while it takes responsibility for local labour-law compliance.

name: Napchief
description: Nap Chief is one of India's youngest D2C kidswear brands, focused on bringing unique and functional fashion to families with kids, with ambitions to go global.

name: NatHabit
description: NatHabit believes natural ingredients are most effective when prepared fresh and used instantly, so it makes products daily in beauty kitchens for absolutely fresh delivery without chemicals or preservatives. Its range spans ubtans, mehendi packs, lip scrubs and more, rich in grains, grams, nuts, milk, yoghurt and fresh herbs.

name: Naturik
description: Naturik is building a modern desi food brand that puts taste first without compromising on health. Using 100% clean ingredients and high-protein, chef-crafted recipes, it delivers convenient meals rooted in authentic Indian flavours.

name: Neend
description: Neend is on a mission to help India sleep better, tackling insomnia driven by disturbed sleep cycles, screen time, lack of exercise and unhealthy habits. After researching the root causes of sleeplessness, it started with Sleep Stories in regional languages and plans further innovative solutions.

name: Neodocs
description: Neodocs translates body information into personalised nutrition and lifestyle advice that fits into daily life, by enabling instant lab tests on a smartphone.

name: Nester Home
description: Nester is a premium brand building homeware to elevate daily home rituals, on the belief that everyday chores like cooking, organising and living should feel like a daily retreat rather than work. It combines high-performance engineering with empathetic design to create products that are as durable as they are beautiful.

name: Netmeds
description: Netmeds.com is a fully licensed e-pharmacy offering authenticated prescription and OTC medicines along with other health products. A first-to-market pan-India solution for quick online purchase and fast delivery of medications, it has served more than 5.7 million customers across 670+ cities and towns.

name: Ninety One
description: Ninety One is a new-age cycle brand - from kids' cycles to electric cycles - on a mission to reconnect modern India with the outdoors through well-engineered products that prioritise safety, durability, comfort and style. Each cycle comes with a lifetime frame warranty and rewards riders for every mile via its wynd app.

name: Nirva Health (Prescribe)
description: Nirva Health is an IIT-Madras alum-founded healthtech startup enabling efficient digital healthcare delivery through powerful technology and patient-friendly platforms like WhatsApp.

name: NOTO
description: NOTO is a healthy, low-calorie ice cream for millennial Indians with a sweet tooth - a good-for-you ice cream you can enjoy guilt-free, with a selection of six flavours.

name: Nova Benefits
description: Nova Benefits is a one-stop tech platform providing the best health and wellness benefits to an organisation's employees. It finds the best deals for companies and makes them easy for employees to access, with no administrative overhead for HR.

name: OfBusiness
description: OfBusiness has built a technology-led ecosystem that addresses the core growth needs of India's SMEs. Spanning procurement, financing, and business intelligence, its three platforms work together to help SMEs source better, access capital faster, and unlock new business opportunities. This integrated approach enables greater efficiency, stronger resilience, and long-term value creation across the SME economy.

name: Ola
description: Ola is India’s mobility platform and a large ride-hailing company, serving 250+ cities across India, Australia, New Zealand and the UK. It connects customers to drivers across bikes, auto-rickshaws, taxis and cabs, and is supplemented by Ola Electric, Ola Fleet Technologies and Ola Skilling.

name: Omli Kids(Companio)
description: Omli is reimagining child development through AI-powered conversational learning that improves speech, communication, and cognitive growth through both app & screenless hardware.

name: OnJuno
description: OnJuno is a modern digital banking platform that helps people manage and grow their idle money, making banking simple and transparent. The neobanking platform is designed to help users grow their savings and reach their financial goals faster.

name: Open Secret
description: Open Secret is un-junking India one snack at a time, providing healthy yet delicious snacking options for families.

name: OZiva
description: OZiva is India's leading clean-label active nutrition brand combining modern food science with ancient Ayurveda. It is committed to supporting everyone who wants to become a better version of themselves.

name: Park+
description: Park+ is building an ecosystem for car owners as a one-stop solution for their needs - from parking reservations and challan payments to FASTag recharge, RTO information, fuel prices and nearest PUC centre search. It also offers smart automated parking solutions to corporates, apartments, malls and hospitals.

name: Peeko
description: Peeko is building the go-to platform for new-age parents, combining rapid commerce, a large curated assortment and home trial-led shopping across baby and kids categories.

name: Pepper Content
description: Pepper Content is a mediation platform connecting talented creators with organisations that need content. It continuously matches the demand and supply of content services, giving businesses access to a talent pool of thousands without managing them directly.

name: Postcard Hotel
description: The Postcard Hotel is a collection of intimate, experiential boutique hotels promising immersive, luxuriously curated holidays. Built for the modern audience and led by carefully chosen hospitality talent from the best names in India and the world, it is rich in experience yet simple.

name: Powerplay
description: Powerplay simplifies end-to-end construction and architecture project management. Top management gets an insightful dashboard to track activities, inventory and blockages in real time, while the app resolves the communication friction between site and office teams that has long been a pain point in the industry.

name: Privado
description: Privado builds tools for compliance with data privacy laws such as GDPR and CCPA. It simplifies and automates tasks like consent capture, vendor assessments and privacy assessments so companies can demonstrate privacy compliance, bringing visibility into data use for privacy teams.

name: Protouch
description: Protouch provides simplified, handy and fuss-free solutions for complex professional beauty treatments at home. It launched India's first LED Hair Growth Therapy Comb paired with ultra-concentrated Biotin & Collagen hair growth drops for a luxury hair-treatment experience at home.

name: Pruf
description: We’re PRUF. And we think your skincare trust issues are perfectly reasonable. We’re building skincare for Indian skin with scientists, dermatologists and a community that asks inconvenient questions. First up: pigmentation and sun protection. Our ingredients have to earn their place in the bottle. Our claims have to survive “okay, but show me.” We’ll share what works, what doesn’t, and the results that make the marketing meeting awkward. We are taking a bet on honesty in a category plagued by miraculous claims. Solving India's skincare trust deficit, one problem at a time :)

name: PTal
description: P-TAL revives age-old traditions in a contemporary way, offering authentic, artisanal kitchenware, cookware and home decor in brass, copper and bronze - metals considered beneficial for health per Ayurveda. Products are handcrafted by the Thatheras of Jandiala Guru, practitioners of India's only UNESCO-listed craft form.

name: Questt
description: Questt builds an AI decision layer powered by autonomous agents that unify data, automate workflows, and deliver measurable ROI across your enterprise.

name: Quinn
description: Quinn helps brands leverage video assets like Instagram reels and TikToks to increase Shopify store revenue. It is live with 10+ leading brands such as Juicy Chemistry, Faces Canada, Arata and The Face Shop, and is backed by the founders of Purplle, Snapdeal, Kwench and Mamaearth.

name: Rapidbox
description: Rapidbox is an app-based footwear commerce platform for consumers.

name: Razorpay
description: Razorpay is India’s first full-stack financial solutions company. It aims to enhance the payment experience of over 300 million end consumers and enable Indian businesses to accept payments digitally with minimal effort and maximum ease. Razorpay has grown from a payment gateway provider to a solutions-driven organization with products to accept and disburse payments, raise capital and park money.

name: Recur
description: Recur is a trading platform facilitating financing for companies with recurring revenues. It lets companies trade recurring revenue contracts or subscriptions as an asset class and convert monthly recurring revenue to upfront growth capital.

name: Refold AI(Cobalt)
description: Cobalt is an embedded integration platform that lets SaaS companies launch two-way native integrations in days rather than months. It provides an SDK, fully managed authentication, end-to-end monitoring and easy deployment, shortening integration delivery time and unlocking stuck revenue.

name: Remedo
description: Remedo lets doctors take control of their practice - digitising records without typing, sending automated reminders and targeted patient communication (including in Hindi), and using waiting times to deliver patient education that delights patients.

name: Renee
description: RENEE Cosmetics is an Indian makeup brand redefining beauty with a high-quality, 100% cruelty-free, innovative product range. It champions empowering women to own their bold, ambitious persona and let their glam do the talking.

name: RevSpot
description: Revspot enables companies to focus sales and marketing efforts on high-intent, in-market prospects aligned with their customer profiles, identifying buying propensity and ability before sales and marketing outreach. It uses enriched demographic, professional, behavioural and psychographic data with a content-consumption intent layer.

name: RidEV

description: CO280 is a developer of large-scale carbon removal projects. The company partners with leading pulp and paper companies to develop carbon dioxide removal (CDR) projects that deliver permanent, verifiable, affordable carbon removal credits to the voluntary carbon market.

name: Cobalt Robotics
description: Cobalt Robotics merges hardware, software, people, and data to transform enterprise security operations. The Cobalt Security Service uses robots on the ground to detect anomalies and a remote operations center to manage incidents, with a Robots-as-a-Service model that unites the benefits of a machine with the flexibility and responsiveness of a human.

name: Common Sense Machines
description: Common Sense Machines is building artificial intelligence that translates the world into a 3D simulation. Its platform, Real-to-Sim, uses state-of-the-art machine learning to flexibly build human-like 3D models of objects, environments, and agents with machine-like speed and precision.

name: Connected Signals
description: Connected Signals is a connected vehicle data analytics company that provides predictive, real-time, traffic signal information using existing infrastructure. This data, derived using sophisticated proprietary models, supports applications that improve safety, increase fuel efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and improve traffic flow.

name: Decart
description: Decart is a vertically integrated frontier AI research lab building state-of-the-art, real-time world models and the infrastructure to run them. Decart’s optimization stack spans model design, data, inference, and productization to enable real-time video at lower cost.

name: Drishti
description: Drishti’s AI-powered video analytics, data and insights from the factory floor bring significant benefits to both manufacturers and the people employed. The company’s mission is to extend human potential in an increasingly automated world.

name: Ecolectro
description: Ecolectro develops an anion exchange membrane (AEM) and electrolyzer stack that enables green hydrogen to scale. The company’s cutting-edge technology eliminates the need for expensive platinum group metals found in today’s fuel cells and electrolyzers, significantly reducing the cost of green hydrogen.

name: Efficient Computer
description: Efficient Computer is transforming general-purpose computing with its ultra-energy-efficient Fabric processor architecture. The company’s technology aims to eliminate significant energy constraints in computing for a wide range of applications through the synergy of its E1 processor and effcc compiler.

name: Elementary
description: Elementary automates quality assurance and traceability with artificial intelligence, deep learning, and camera systems that are built to capture visual data and deliver fast and reliable real-time judgments.

name: Embodied
description: Embodied builds socially and emotionally intelligent robots, called animate companions. Embodied’s first product, Moxie, is an animate companion for children that helps promote social, emotional and cognitive learning.

name: eZinc
description: On a mission to enable a zero-carbon energy future, e-Zinc has developed a breakthrough electrochemical technology for storing energy in zinc metal. The company’s low-cost, flexible, and long-duration energy storage solution is designed to provide the platform for the world’s energy markets to be fully powered by renewable energy.

name: Flai
description: Flai is an AI-powered communications platform that automates inbound and outbound customer interaction for car dealerships, utilizing multilingual AI assistants that support service and sales.

name: Freedom Robotics
description: Freedom Robotics builds mission-critical software infrastructure to enable the next generation of robotics companies to build, operate, and scale robots and robotic fleets. The company’s platform-agnostic software is designed to work with any robot.

name: Future Fields
description: Future Fields deploys insect biotechnology to produce quality biomolecules for science. Its EntoEngine platform harnesses the genetic prowess of fruit flies to produce environmentally and economically sustainable recombinant proteins for bioproducts.

name: Haiqu
description: Haiqu is developing platform-agnostic technology that extends quantum hardware capability by orders of magnitude and enables a broader set of practical use-cases in finance, chemistry, life sciences, mobility, and other domains.

name: Hertha Metals
description: Hertha aims to produce lower-cost, lower-emission steel and high-purity iron domestically. Its single-step process is designed to reduce costs by up to 25% and cut emissions by up to 50%. Hertha operates a major single-step demonstration facility and is working to establish domestic high-purity iron production.

name: Holyheld
description: Holyheld is building a solution that allows traditional payment rails and on-chain agents to interact with each other seamlessly.

name: Intuition Robotics
description: Intuition Robotics is building long-term relationships between people and technology with ElliQ, an empathetic robot that provides offers older adults support in the areas of wellness, companionship, and health care.

name: ION Storage Systems
description: ION Storage Systems’ nonflammable technology creates high energy density solid state lithium metal batteries that are safer, lighter and enable form factors with tighter packing density.

name: Joby Aviation
description: Joby Aviation is developing an all-electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) passenger aircraft designed to help reduce urban congestion through an aerial ridesharing service. On August 11, 2021, Joby began trading on the NYSE with the ticker symbol “JOBY.”

name: Kolors
description: Kolors is transforming the intercity bus industry through technology, data and customer experience. The company is creating the largest intercity bus network without owning a single vehicle, and running it like an airline on wheels.

name: Living Carbon
description: Living Carbon uses advanced biotechnology to develop photosynthesis-enhanced trees. The company is on a mission to balance the planet’s carbon cycle by restoring ecosystems, improving biodiversity, and increasing the ability of photosynthetic organisms to draw down and store carbon.

name: Matter Intelligence
description: Matter Intelligence specializes in advancing space sensors that capture incredibly detailed images of both natural and artificial materials, creating a comprehensive high-resolution dataset of Earth’s surface and atmosphere. This data powers industries and helps AI models better understand and predict real-world events.

name: May Mobility
description: May Mobility is an enterprise autonomous transportation company that provides daily transit to people in local communities. The company’s mission is to transform cities through autonomous technology to create a safer, greener, more accessible world.

name: Metawave
description: Metawave seeks to revolutionize the future of automotive radar sensing and wireless communications. Leveraging its proprietary AI software, Metawave is building advanced analog beam-steering radars to make cars safer and smarter. The company is also developing smart antenna platforms to enable faster, more efficient 5G deployments.

name: Monogoto
description: Monogoto is a cloud-based global cellular network. Its API-driven “connectivity-as-a-service” platform enables secure IoT connectivity and private 5G/LTE networks, with seamless interoperability between public, private, and non-terrestrial network satellite infrastructure.

name: Moodify
description: Moodify develops advanced scent solutions for improved performance and well-being. Their “functional fragrance” technology is designed to harness the power of smell by emitting safe, non-intrusive signals that can mask bad odors, decrease stress, or wake up someone who is drowsy.

name: Natura Resources
description: Natura Resources is an advanced nuclear reactor developer pioneering liquid-fueled, molten salt reactors. Natura’s small modular reactor is designed to deliver scalable, cost-efficient solutions that can safely meet the world’s growing demand for power, water desalination, and medical isotopes.

name: Nauto
description: Nauto develops a real-time, AI-powered Driver Behavior Learning Platform that uses machine learning algorithms to predict, actively prevent, and reduce high-risk events, like distracted driving. Trusted by nearly 800 fleets worldwide, Nauto helps customers reduce up to 80% of collisions with predictive driver alerts. On July 1, 2026, Nauto announced a merger with Nexar.

name: Near Space Labs
description: Near Space Labs is a geospatial intelligence company that is democratizing access to Earth imaging with its cost-effective and zero-emission flights. Near Space’s Swiftys capture 400 – 1,000 square kilometers of imagery per flight, producing higher-resolution images with more coverage than traditional alternatives.

name: Neuromorphic Labs
description: Neuromorphic Labs is building the trust layer for production AI. Its platform helps organizations build, deploy, and operate their AI applications with verifiable control over models, weights, data, agents and the environments they run in.

name: Nori
description: Nori is a carbon removal marketplace facilitating end-to-end transparency around the generation and sale of carbon offsets using the Ethereum blockchain. Nori connects carbon removers directly to offset buyers who want to support verified carbon removal.

name: Orbital Industries
description: Leveraging its proprietary foundation model, Orbital Industries uses generative AI to develop and commercialize advanced materials for sustainable fuels, carbon capture, and removing harmful chemicals from the environment.

name: Oxylus Energy
description: Oxylus Energy develops technology to convert carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) into carbon-neutral fuels and chemical feedstocks through direct electrochemical reduction to green methanol. The company’s modular electrolyzers are designed to enable onsite carbon utilization and fuel production, aiding in the decarbonization of challenging sectors like shipping, aviation, and petrochemicals.

name: Paladin
description: Paladin develops software and hardware solutions to help first responders increase their situational awareness and operate more effectively. By deploying state-of-the-art LTE-enabled drone technology in response to 911 calls, Paladin empowers first responders with the tools they need to enhance public safety and improve outcomes in critical situations.

name: Parallel Domain
description: Parallel Domain powers autonomous systems with synthetic data, enabling customers to develop their technology in safe virtual environments and allowing them to deploy in a fraction of the time and for a fraction of the cost.

name: Perceptive Automata
description: Perceptive Automata is solving one of the hardest problems of automated driving: enabling vehicles to predict and understand human behavior. Perceptive Automata allows autonomous systems to anticipate human reactions so they can navigate safely and smoothly around pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers.

name: Periodic Labs
description: Periodic Labs is building AI scientists and the autonomous laboratories for them to operate.

name: Pickle Robot
description: Pickle Robot is pioneering physical AI for supply chain applications by developing a robotic truck unloader to serve the global logistics industry.

name: Pila Energy
description: Pila Energy is building a distributed home battery platform with plug-in design and networked intelligence. Pila batteries turn everyday appliances into smart power hubs that optimize usage, manage energy costs, and provide essential backup power, empowering households while creating a resilient, decentralized grid.

name: Realtime Robotics
description: Realtime Robotics focuses on transforming how robots move. Through a combination of proprietary software and hardware, the company’s platform enables real-time, collision-free motion planning in unstructured environments.

name: Relectrify
description: Headquartered in Australia, Relectrify is a battery energy storage company leveraging its proprietary CellSwitch® platform to increase the lifespan and efficiency of battery systems. The company aims to help reduce the cost of renewable energy by making energy storage better.

name: Renewabl
description: Renewabl is accelerating the adoption of renewables through an advanced technology platform that enables businesses to analyze their clean energy portfolio and trade temporal-matched solutions based on their consumption profile.

name: Revel
description: Revel is electrifying cities through electric vehicle charging infrastructure. With the Revel app, users can find fast-charging EV stations in New York City and San Francisco. On May 26, 2026, Revel announced a merger with Voltera.

name: River
description: River is an electric mobility company building two-wheeled vehicles in India. With a design-first approach and strong focus on engineering, River is creating a new customer segment to deliver high-quality, affordable, and stylish multi-utility scooters.

name: Rock Zero
description: Rock Zero is reinventing hardrock lithium refining by developing chemical technology that lowers the cost and environmental impact of converting lithium-bearing minerals into battery-grade chemicals.

name: Rodatherm
description: Rodatherm is a geothermal energy company that is harnessing the Earth’s natural heat with a patented closed-loop system to generate clean, cost-effective, and reliable electricity.

name: Scentian Bio
description: Scentian Bio is a biosensor company that is developing state-of-the-art bioelectronic technology based on the extraordinary sensitivity of insect smell receptors. By enabling devices to “smell” and “taste” chemical compounds, the platform has the potential to revolutionize medical diagnostics, food quality, environmental monitoring, crop management, and more.

name: Sea Machines
description: Sea Machines Robotics is an autonomous technology company that specializes in advanced control technology for workboats and other commercial surface vessels.

name: Skip
description: Skip’s mission is to energize cities by making mobility accessible to everyone. The company believes this requires designing every aspect of a micromobility network from the ground up, including custom vehicle hardware, a software-defined fleet management system, and ground operations for safety and recharging.

name: SLAMcore
description: SLAMcore develops full-stack “Spatial AI” solutions for robots and drones. The company’s suite of algorithms translate sensor information into spatial intelligence, closing the loop between perception and action.

name: Starfish Space
description: Starfish Space is developing the Otter servicing vehicle to extend the lives of satellites in geostationary orbit and dispose of space debris in low-Earth orbit. Otter vehicles will ultimately enable satellite upgrades, orbit maintenance, large structure assembly, and more.

name: STOKE Space
description: STOKE Space develops fully and rapidly reusable rockets to provide the satellite industry with reliable, low-cost access to and from any orbit on a routine basis. This critical infrastructure can help us collectively address global issues like climate change.

name: SummerBio
description: SummerBio is a diagnostics company that has developed a high-quality solution for rapid, affordable, high-volume COVID-19 testing, using state-of-the-art robotics and automated liquid handling systems.

name: Supercritical
description: Supercritical is pioneering technology to offer a route to the lowest cost of pressurized green hydrogen. The company’s high-pressure, ultra-efficient electrolyzer technology delivers green hydrogen at pressures exceeding 220 bar with over 99% purity.

name: Syzygy Plasmonics
description: Syzygy Plasmonics is a deep-decarbonization company that is building reactors that use light instead of heat to electrify chemical manufacturing and power a cleaner, safer world.

name: Tangent Robotics
description: Tangent Robotics combines touch sensing, custom hand design, and motor learning to bring fine motor skills to robotic manipulation. The company’s platform targets high-value, delicate operational tasks to automate the last mile of manufacturing.

name: Teller
description: Teller is a decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol that enables unsecured digital assets lending and borrowing through an open order book model. Marketplaces and lending platforms can integrate Teller to package loan requests, allowing lenders to decide what loans to fill based on the appended borrower data.

name: Tensordyne
description: The Tensordyne inference system is an AI-inference platform that delivers super-node capacity at a fraction of the energy, space, and cost. The technology is drop-in data center compatible, air-cooled, and scales without grid strain, enabling faster, more affordable, and sustainable generative AI.

name: Tereform
description: Tereform has developed a chemical recycling process for blends of synthetic textiles, converting waste textiles into newly recycled fabrics while minimizing costly sorting and pre-processing steps. This enables the recycling of challenging post-consumer waste streams that would otherwise end up in landfills or incinerators.

name: Third Wave
description: Third Wave is deploying a combination of software and hardware to build the most advanced autonomous forklift. Third Wave’s transformative technology increases safety, efficiency, and throughput by leveraging shared autonomy — a breakthrough in machine learning, computer vision, and robotic material handling.

name: Universal Hydrogen
description: Universal Hydrogen is working to make carbon-free commercial flight a near-term reality, by transporting hydrogen in modular capsules over the existing freight network to airports around the world.

name: Vow
description: Vow is creating unique and sustainable culinary experiences by culturing real meat from cells, rather than the animal itself. By automating its manufacturing processes, Vow aims to bring its alternative proteins to the world at scale.

name: Walden Robotics
description: Walden Robotics is a full-stack physical AI company building and deploying general-purpose robots. Designed for real-world environments, these machines continuously learn and improve on the job, performing practical work to deliver highly adaptable, intelligent automation.

name: Xona Space Systems
description: Xona Space Systems is on a mission to enable modern technologies to operate safely in any environment, anywhere on Earth. Utilizing the efficiency of small satellites, Xona is developing a secure satellite navigation service with unprecedented precision and interference mitigation.

name: Yard Stick
description: Yard Stick PBC is a handheld hardware and data platform that measures soil carbon through an affordable and scalable process. By reducing the cost of soil carbon measurement, Yard Stick will activate soils to improve ecosystem health, increase revenue for sustainable farming practices, and help combat climate change.

description: Zeno is building a full-stack battery-as-a-service energy ecosystem to power movement, life and work in fast-growing parts of the world. Starting in East Africa and India, Zeno is building a flexible, multimodal charging ecosystem and seeding it with a rough-road, heavy-load electric sport utility motorbike.

name: Zeti
description: Zeti is revolutionizing the conversion of traditional fleets to zero-emission vehicles and infrastructure. Using a unique pay-per-mile model, its fintech platform provides benefits to both the fleet operator and source of finance, replacing the traditional leasing model with simplicity, ease of use and transparency.

Ziva’s groundbreaking technology uses physics-embedded soft tissue simulation to create high-quality virtual humans and creatures with dynamic muscles, fat, and skin that automatically flex, wrinkle, and move like they would in real life. On January 24, 2022, Unity Technologies announced its acquisition of Ziva.

description: AppNexus built technology for buying and selling digital advertising programmatically. The company was acquired by AT&T in 2018.

name: Artemis
description: Artemis Power is a software platform that helps solar installers design, price, finance, and sell residential solar and energy systems using AI-driven automation. The company provides an end-to-end tool that generates solar system designs, pricing proposals, financing options, and contracts in seconds, allowing installers to dramatically shorten the sales cycle and reduce operational complexity.

name: Backtrace
description: Backtrace provides crash reporting and error analysis that help software teams identify and resolve failures. It was acquired by Sauce Labs.

name: Bakpax
description: Bakpax developed AI-assisted grading software that recognized students’ handwriting and helped teachers review assignments. It was acquired by Teachers Pay Teachers.

name: BetterCloud
description: BetterCloud provides SaaS management software that helps IT teams automate user administration, manage software spending and govern files. CoreStack acquired the company in March 2026.

description: Bland is a voice AI platform for deploying production-grade AI agents across phone, SMS, and chat, enabling companies to automate customer interactions and drive measurable business outcomes.

description: Loft is a space infrastructure company that provides a simple, fast, and reliable way to deploy missions to low Earth orbit. Loft has developed a standardized satellite platform that can be configured to fly any customer mission. With its own hardware and software abstraction layers on top of a commodity satellite bus, Loft’s platform is truly turnkey and plug-and-play.

description: Radical AI is a scientific research and technology company that uses artificial intelligence, automation, and robotics to transform materials discovery and development. They dramatically speed up the traditional, slow process of creating new materials by building a closed-loop, autonomous discovery platform.

name: ShopKeep
description: ShopKeep built cloud-based point-of-sale software for independent businesses. It was acquired by Lightspeed in 2020.

name: Spiffy

description: Auth0, a global leader in Identity-as-a-Service (IDaaS), provides thousands of enterprise customers with a Universal Identity Platform for their web, mobile, IoT, and internal applications. name: New Relic
description: Serial entrepreneur Lew Cirne founded New Relic in 2008 with a revolutionary vision: to deliver application performance monitoring (APM) as a purely SaaS product. By embracing the power and accessibility of the cloud, New Relic grew rapidly and quickly became an integral tool for developers, IT ops teams, and executives around the world.

name: Markforged
description: As one of the most well-respected, innovative and rapidly growing 3D printing companies, Markforged’s mission is to provide its customers with high strength parts, built right the first time. In 2014, Markforged revolutionized 3D printing with the introduction of the world’s first carbon-fiber composite 3D printer. Today, Markforged’s lineup of innovative printers and their groundbreaking materials along with Eiger cloud software are making strong parts for thousands of customers in over 50 countries around the world. Markforged Industrial Strength 3D Printers produce mission-critical, workhorse parts that solve real problems for their customers, and realize structures never before possible.

name: Mapper.ai
description: Mapper is building the world’s largest repository of up-to-date, machine-readable base maps.

name: Mobilize
description: Mobilize is designed for networked companies to recruit, onboard, manage and mobilize their partners into action via communication experiences that are relevant, helpful and actionable. We’re on a mission to drive the transformation towards a healthy, networked economy, one mobilized network after another.

name: Property Capsule
description: Property Capsule is a cloud-based technology platform that helps its users manage and present their property portfolio. It simplifies the centralization, automation, and publication of property information. Its platform keeps property data, such as property overviews, agent contacts, site plans, tenant lists, photography, maps, and demographics in a central repository; and enables its users to update property information in the system using a web-based interface.

name: Figure Eight
description: Figure Eight (formerly CrowdFlower) is the essential human-in-the-loop AI platform for data science and machine learning teams. Figure Eight helps customers generate high-quality customized training data for their machine learning initiatives, or automate a business process with easy-to-deploy models and integrated human-in-the-loop workflows. The Figure Eight software platform supports a wide range of use cases including self-driving cars, intelligent personal assistants, medical image labeling, content categorization, customer support ticket classification, social data insight, CRM data enrichment, product categorization, and search relevance.

name: Workpop
description: Workpop is an online jobs marketplace and hiring solution. With a smart, easy-to-use platform, we empower millions of people and businesses in the service economy.

name: Turo
description: Founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, Turo is a car rental marketplace where travelers can rent any car they want, wherever they want it, from a vibrant community of local car owners. Travelers choose from a totally unique selection of nearby cars, while car owners earn extra money and help fuel their adventures. A pioneer of the sharing economy and travel industry, Turo is a safe, supportive community where the car you rent is part of a story, not a fleet. Whether it’s an F-150 truck to help out on moving day, a Tesla for a luxurious weekend away, or a classic VW bus for a picture-perfect road trip, travelers rent the car and own the adventure.

name: Outreach
description: Outreach is a sales engagement platform that accelerates revenue growth by optimizing every interaction throughout the customer life cycle. The platform manages all customer interactions across email, voice and social, and leverages machine learning to guide reps to take the right actions. Thousands of customers, including Cloudera, Glassdoor, Pandora, and Zillow, rely on Outreach to drive predictable and measurable growth, increase efficiency and effectiveness of customer-facing teams, and improve visibility into sales activity and performance.

name: Side
description: Side is the only real estate brokerage that transforms agents into businesses. We exclusively partner with the best agents to create, grow, and power their own business, without the cost, time, or risk. It’s hard to grow your business alone, but we make it easy.

name: Cohesity
description: Cohesity’s hyperconverged technology is fundamentally transforming enterprise infrastructure across public and private clouds. Enterprise customers begin by radically streamlining their backup and data protection, then converge file and object services, test/dev instances, and analytic functions to provide a global data store.

name: Bevi
description: Bevi is on a mission to unbottle the future and replace mass-produced bottled beverages with custom drinks mixed at the point of use. Bevi believes that you shouldn’t have to choose between what’s good for you and what’s good for the environment and is creating a world in which you can do both. From proactive monitoring software to intuitive touchscreen UX, Bevi is changing the way the world thinks about personalized beverages using user-centered design.

name: VTS
description: Nick Romito and Ryan Masiello, two long-time friends who were both working in the commercial real estate industry, noticed a need in the market for a platform to help owners and brokers streamline their workflows and lease space faster. They formed VTS and in 2012 launched the industry’s first leasing and asset management focused platform. Since then, with the help of co-founder and CTO Karl Baum, the VTS platform has become a comprehensive ecosystem where owners and brokers can manage deal activity, identify trends and quantify portfolio performance all from one dashboard. In November 2016, VTS merged with Hightower, bringing owners, investors and brokers from around the globe together in one platform. Hightower co-founders Brandon Weber, Donald DeSantis and Niall Smart joined the senior leadership of the new combined organization. With over 5 billion square feet under management, VTS is the driving force behind the industry’s shift toward real-time data.

name: Thrive Causemetics
description: Thrive Causemetics was born out of a friendship. Makeup artist and product developer, Karissa Bodnar, lost her dear friend Kristy to cancer at just 24 years old. Kristy’s compassionate and vivacious spirit inspired Karissa to establish Thrive Causemetics, a beauty brand and philosophy that goes beyond skin deep by empowering women.

name: CommerceIQ
description: CommerceIQ™, the world’s first and only unified Amazon platform, enables brands to achieve profitable sales growth on Amazon by improving the operational efficiency of their Amazon e-commerce business using machine learning and automation technology. CommerceIQ™ unifies Amazon sales, advertising, operations, and competitor data on one platform, applies machine learning to surface latent inefficiencies and growth opportunities, and automates actions to realize the benefits from these opportunities. CommerceIQ™ is headquartered in Mountain View, CA with offices in Seattle and Bangalore.

name: BirdEye
description: We live in a connected world and BirdEye's leading platform connects reputation and customer experience. BirdEye allows businesses to see their comprehensive BirdEye view i.e. what their customers are saying across all channels — review sites, social media, NPS surveys, support cases. BirdEye's natural language processing (NLP) and big data engine converts all the unstructured customer feedback into actionable insights, so businesses can benchmark performance across all their locations, and vs. competitors.

name: InfluxData

Developers can query and analyze their time-stamped data in real-time to discover, interpret, and share new insights to gain a competitive edge.

name: Baton Systems
description: Baton is a financial technology company that builds payments middle-ware based on distributed ledger technology. The Baton platform facilitates clearing and settlement for both securities and currencies at scale, providing a faster and less costly method for financial institutions. They're providing information, motivation, and accountability for their users as they embark on their journey toward wellness.

description: Aeromutable is bringing aerospace technology into the trucking industry through designing and manufacturing aerodynamic modification systems that increase vehicle efficiency and safety. Aeromutable’s first product is a non-intrusive trailer add-on system that improves aerodynamic performance and provides 3 times the fuel savings of its nearest competitors, saving 9.76B gallons of fuel per year in the US alone and providing the trucking industry the ability to increase profitability while massively reducing their carbon footprint.

name: Aloqia
description: Aloqia enables companies to take action on excess inventory by reusing, reselling, and recycling deadstock through one-of-a-kind climate fintech software. Activities are measured and reported while turning pollution into profit and easily integrates directly into the existing inventory management software; current customers have seen a 15%+ reduction in costs optimizing supply chain operations globally.

name: Atlantic Sea Farms
description: Atlantic Sea Farms produces innovative, fresh sea vegetable products under the brand name Atlantic Sea Farms . Their products are never dried or dyed and are farmed by independent lobstermen in the clean cold waters of Maine. Seaweed farming improves water quality, produces a food high in essential vitamins and minerals, and creates a supplemental income source for Maine’s fishermen. Atlantic Sea Farms is the first to market with a fresh, domestic sea vegetable product and their easy-to-use products make kelp approachable and delicious.

name: BrainCheck
description: BrainCheck provides rapid, mobile cognitive assessment tools and personalized cognitive care planning. Assessments take about 10 minutes, can be performed anywhere, and deliver results on the spot. The system also provides clinical decision support to physicians, allowing them to provide cognitive health education, remote monitoring, and personalized cognitive care management. They are an FDA Class II Medical Device and reimbursable by insurance.

name: Dalinea
description: Dalinea is a procurement intelligence platform purpose-built for visibility, forecasting, and impact— down to the SKU level. Designed by procurement professionals, it empowers teams to anticipate tariff shifts, counter supplier price hikes, and integrate carbon data into sourcing decisions. Dalinea transforms procurement from reactive to strategic by surfacing the real drivers of cost and risk— enabling smarter negotiations, more resilient supply chains, and measurable bottom-line results.

name: De Oro Devices
description: De Oro Devices makes mobility assistive devices to allow people with mobility disorders to walk confidently and safely. Their beachhead market is in Parkinson’s Disease where they help overcome freezing of gait, one of the most common and most debilitating symptoms of Parkinson’s. De Oro’s initial patent-pending device, NexStride, combines a green laser line visual cue and a metronome auditory cue into a small portable device that can attach to any cane, walker, or walking pole.

name: Dermala
description: Dermala utilizes the human microbiome to develop the next generation of OTC dermatology treatments for the most prevalent skin diseases and conditions, such as acne, eczema and aging. Backed by IP exclusively licensed from a university as well as independently developed, Dermala uses prebiotic and probiotic formulations to improve skin health naturally. Leveraging a technology-driven mobile app solution, Dermala delivers personalized treatments to further optimize outcomes.

name: Flourish
description: Flourish helps women get healthy for good by teaching their members to build sustainable habits across the full spectrum of behavioral health: nutrition, hydration, sleep, stress, relationships, and movement. Flourish incorporates gold standard practices that were previously only available through meeting one-on-one and often in-person with a registered dietitian or therapist. Flourish delivers virtually and at scale through a subscription membership offering personalized coaching from credentialed health experts, community support, and evidence-based education.

name: Flowly
description: Flowly is a mobile platform for chronic pain and anxiety. Flowly teaches you to control your heart rate and breathing so that you can better manage your nervous system. Flowly takes you from a state of pain, anxiety, or stress, and transitions you into a state of Flow: relaxed yet focused. All experiences can be accessed just on the phone or in Virtual Reality. Flowly also includes an in-app community where users can share resources and experiences.

name: Fort Health
description: Fort Health is a virtual mental health platform providing fast, accessible care for children and adolescents. By leveraging teletherapy and collaborating with leading institutions like the Child Mind Institute, Fort Health offers evidence-based treatment, including therapy and medication management. Their model eliminates traditional barriers, offering families convenient access to top mental health professionals while prioritizing measurable outcomes and personalized care plans to improve youth mental well-being.

name: Jiminy’s
description: By thinking differently about the protein source in our pet’s food, Jiminy’s created a better dog food that delivers enormous benefit. Jiminy’s makes delicious, sustainable, insect-based dog food and treats that nourish pets and promote long-term stewardship of the earth. Jiminy’s has made a commitment to fighting climate change, and with their products they’ve made it easy for pet parents to make an eco-friendly choice for their furry kids.

name: Oralucent
description: Oralucent is the world’s most effective toothbrush and is set to revolutionize oral care. The patented sonic toothbrush emits a type of blue light that is proven to whiten teeth and eradicate harmful bacteria that cause plaque, gum disease, and bad breath. The class 1 medical device overcomes limitations of the mechanical toothbrush by cleaning hard to reach locations between the teeth and below the gum line with no change in brushing habits.

name: Ovum Health
description: Ovum Health is the exclusive lifestyle medicine provider for pre-pregnancy and pre-IVF care, delivering medically supervised programs that improve health and fertility outcomes and reduce costly interventions. By embedding directly within IVF clinics and partnering with employers, Ovum becomes the first step before treatment. Ovum’s data-driven approach drives higher pregnancy rates, lowers healthcare costs, and addresses root causes of infertility—positioning Ovum as critical infrastructure in the fertility care continuum.

name: Partum Health
description: Partum Health is a digital care company working to radically improve the health of women and families, starting with fertility, pregnancy, and early family life. Partum’s care model brings together experts including perinatal mental health providers, physical therapists, birth doulas, postpartum doulas, lactation consultants and more. Families get the best of online and offline care including digital care coordination, telehealth and in person care to comprehensively prevent complications and address their full range of health needs.

name: Point Health
description: PointHealth is a clinical AI platform embedded directly within electronic health records (EHRs) that helps clinicians make more precise treatment decisions, starting with behavioral health. Today, only 30–40% of patients respond to their first prescribed medication for depression, leading to prolonged suffering, unnecessary side effects, and increased costs. PointHealth doubles the success of prescriptions by using AI to compare each patient to millions of similar patient journeys and recommend treatments based on real-world outcomes.

name: Refiberd
description: Over 186 billion pounds of textile waste are generated each year, and less than 1% is recycled into new clothing. Refiberd is solving this global textile waste crisis through their patent-pending system that can process post-consumer waste into brand new textile products. Refiberd’s textile recycling system has two stages: 1) an AI and robotics-based system which sorts discarded textiles by material and color, and 2) an eco-friendly chemical textile recycling process which converts the sorted textiles into new Refiberd thread.

name: reHarvest
description: reHarvest crafts frozen smoothie products that do good. reHarvest delivers tasty and nutrient-dense smoothies that radically tackle food loss via their commitment to reHARVEST and rePURPOSE unnecessarily discarded produce. All products are formulated with clean and functional ingredients that do good for your body and the world around you. reHarvest also incorporates innovative packaging solutions that allow their products to be shipped at ambient temperature, avoiding environmental impacts and costs of a cold supply chain.

name: Rosy
description: Designed by doctors and psychologists, Rosy creates solutions to empower women on their journey to sexual wellness. Rosy’s novel mobile platform offers an evidence-based, holistic approach to sexual health including education, behavioral interventions, community, and personalized support, and it’s now recommended by more than 3500 healthcare professionals for sexual health concerns. In a recent study, Rosy users experienced a statistically significant improvement in multiple aspects of sexual function including desire, arousal, orgasm and pain.
